jobs.description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

This role focuses on discovering long-tail events in Zoox fleet driving logs by combining data mining techniques with the latest AI and Vision Language Model (VLM) capabilities. You will work with Zoox’s rich AV driving data, define what makes a driving moment interesting, build curated datasets of rare scenarios, and identify scenes with value for feature development, and public storytelling.

Responsibilities

Develop detailed scenario specifications and translate them into production level code to search AV fleet driving logs for long-tail events.
Use the latest AI models and VLMs to filter candidate scenes.
Review candidate scenes, take part in the end to end life cycle, improvement and maintenance of automated mining and triage tools.

Required Qualifications

Build and maintain curated datasets of long-tail events that flag compelling scenes.
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with modern AI models or VLMs through APIs, coursework, or projects.
Track discovery progress and communicate with stakeholders within and outside the core development team.
Creative problem solving and strong communication skills.

Bonus Qualifications

Experience with big data systems such as Spark.
Robotics or AV data is a plus.
Recommender systems and content curation.

Program Requirements

Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

, located in New York, NY, is the U.S. headquarters of Sony Group Corporation, based in Tokyo, Japan. Sony Corporation of America seeks a Senior Research Engineer for its U.S. Research Center in San Jose, CA to drive research in 3D image processing, computer graphics, and 3D image compression by creating, validating, and optimizing algorithms for structure from motion, point clouds, meshes, and new representations (e.g., NeRF and Gaussian splats), delivering reproducible results and efficient solutions for product integration.

Job Responsibilities

Ensure technical relevance by evaluating current and emerging 3D compression technologies.
Deliver new 3D imaging concepts by taking them from initial design through product integration and market release.
Validate capability and quality by performing feasibility studies and experimental evaluations.
Deliver robust implementations by designing algorithm architectures and applying advanced engineering and mathematical principles.
Achieve cross-platform performance targets by optimizing algorithm performance across a variety of platforms.
Ensure consistent evaluation by defining test procedures and evaluation methodologies.
Sustain high-quality algorithms and software applications by providing advanced technical expertise across design, development, and maintenance.
Increase capability by writing code that improves or extends existing solutions.
Restore reliability by diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex application issues.
Improve outcomes by developing new technical and domain expertise and applying it to products and research problems.
Ensure reproducibility by documenting all phases of research and development.
Secure intellectual property by drafting and filing invention disclosures and collaborating with patent attorneys.
Influence international standards by contributing technical proposals and participating in standards meetings.
Disseminate results by drafting professional articles for technical journals as required.
Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above

Qualifications For Position

Your qualifications and experience should include:

PhD (or MS with a minimum of 3 years of related experience) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

Research experience in point cloud, mesh, and/or Gaussian splats reconstruction and compression (e.g., peer-reviewed work, prototypes, or standards-related experimentation).
Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python (e.g., production-quality code, performance profiling/optimization, and reproducible experimentation).
Experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch (e.g., experimentation, training/inference pipelines, or integrating learned components).
Excellent communication and presentation skills (e.g., clear technical writing, conference or internal talks, and cross-functional collaboration).
Proficiency in Linux-based development environments.

Remote work can be considered after an extensive period of on-site training and may require monthly business trips to the head office.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Ivanti empowers organisations to manage and secure technology smarter through our AI‑powered Ivanti Neurons platform. We help IT and Security teams reduce complexity, work proactively, and deliver better outcomes at scale for customers around the world.
Ivanti helps organisations work smarter through Autonomous Endpoint Management powered by our AI‑driven Ivanti Neurons platform—delivering better outcomes for our customers by reducing complexity and enabling proactive IT and security operations.
About the Role

We're looking for a rare, full-stack data and AI practitioner who can operate fluidly from raw data all the way to production AI systems and the enterprise architecture that supports them. You will ingest and reason over everything from highly structured warehouse data in Snowflake to messy unstructured sources, turn it into defensible analytics, and ship agentic AI solutions that are both intelligent and ruthlessly cost-efficient. 
This is a builder-first role with real architectural ownership. You'll write the models and the agents yourself, and you'll define the reference architectures, patterns, and standards that let the rest of the organization build on top of your work. If you're equally comfortable defending a confidence interval and a system-design decision, this role is for you. 
What You'll Do

Unify structured and unstructured data.
Build pipelines that pull structured data from Snowflake (and adjacent warehouses/lakes) alongside unstructured sources — text, documents, logs, transcripts — into clean, modeling-ready datasets. 

Deliver decision-grade analytics.
Produce customer churn analytics with properly quantified uncertainty (confidence/credible intervals), not just point estimates, and communicate what the numbers can and can't support. 

Build predictive and prescriptive models.
Move beyond "what will happen" to "what should we do about it" — forecasting, propensity, and optimization/recommendation systems that drive concrete business actions. 

Engineer agentic AI systems.
Design and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that are token-efficient by design — tight context management, retrieval and caching strategies, model routing, and evaluation harnesses that keep cost and latency low without sacrificing quality. 

Architect for the enterprise.
Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and governance standards spanning data ingestion, model development, MLOps/LLMOps, security, and observability — and bring stakeholders along with clear diagrams and documentation. 

Own quality and reliability.
Establish evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for drift, accuracy, bias, safety, and cost across both classical ML and GenAI systems. 

Partner across the business.
Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. 

What You Bring (Required)

Strong hands-on data engineering with Snowflake
(modeling, performance, cost management) and SQL, plus experience wrangling unstructured data. 

Solid applied statistics: you can build churn/retention models and correctly express uncertainty with confidence or credible intervals
, and you understand the assumptions behind them. 

Demonstrated experience building predictive and prescriptive analytics
that shipped and influenced decisions. 

Production experience with LLM/agentic systems
— frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, CrewAI, or custom orchestrators — with a real track record of optimizing for token efficiency, cost, and latency
. 

Production RAG
experience (chunking, hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evals) is strongly expected at the senior+ level. 

Architecture chops:
you can design and document end-to-end systems and patterns others build on, and defend those decisions with evidence. 

Strong Python and a software-engineering mindset (testing, version control, CI/CD). 

Excellent written and verbal communication; comfort working asynchronously in a distributed team. 

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer) and/or TOGAF
for enterprise architecture. 

Experience with inference optimization (quantization, model routing, caching, vLLM/TensorRT-style serving). 

MLOps/LLMOps tooling and platform-building experience. 

Domain experience in [your industry], and prior work owning AI strategy or build-vs-buy decisions. 

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

A unified data foundation that combines Snowflake and unstructured sources for downstream modeling. 

A churn analytics product trusted by the business, with quantified uncertainty and clear recommended actions. 

At least one production agentic solution that demonstrably reduces token spend/latency versus a naive baseline while meeting quality bars. 

A documented reference architecture and set of standards adopted by other teams. 

Why Ivanti?

Friendly flexible working model:
Empower excellence whether you’re at home or in the office and support work-life balance .

Competitive compensation & total rewards
: Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family.
Global, diverse teams:
Collaborate with talented people from 23+ countries.
Learning & development:
Grow your skills with access to best-in-class learning tools and programs.
Equity & belonging:
We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world.

What drives us

Ivanti’s mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation.
It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world-class solutions for our customers.
To learn more about Ivanti’s Mission and Core Values.  
Inclusion at Ivanti

Ivanti is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
. We’re committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. Need adjustments during the process? Reach out to talent@ivanti.com we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: AI & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant - Databricks - Senior - Consulting - Location OPEN
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Our AI, Data & Engineering team helps apply cutting edge technology and techniques to bring solutions to our clients. As part of that, you'll sit side-by-side with clients and diverse teams from EY to create a well-rounded approach to advising and solving challenging problems, some of which have not been solved before. No two days will be the same, and with constant research and development, you'll find yourself building knowledge that can be applied across a wide range of projects now, and in the future. You'll need to have a passion for continuous learning, stay ahead of the trends, and influence new ways of working so you can position solutions in the most relevant and innovative way for our clients. You can expect heavy client interaction in a fast-paced environment and the opportunity to develop your own career path for your unique skills and ambitions.

EY is experiencing significant growth in consulting services centered on Databricks, a market-leading data and AI platform. We are seeking an accomplished leader who combines strong business acumen, consulting experience, and technical credibility to help clients realize value from this strategic platform. In this role, you will collaborate with clients and Databricks account, sector, and leadership teams to shape and deliver generative AI use cases, advanced data and AI solutions, and scalable platforms.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing how businesses leverage artificial intelligence. Your role will involve researching, building, and implementing scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems on Databricks that learn, reason, and generate outputs tailored to diverse business environments. You will enhance data pipelines to ensure data integrity and optimize learning processes, all while collaborating with a talented team of data and analytics professionals. You will deliver AI solutions on Databricks, from data pipelines to agents in production.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute significantly to the delivery of innovative AI solutions. You will work with a wide variety of clients to deliver modern AI engineering, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. Your teams will design and build scalable solutions that unify, enrich, and derive insights from varied data sources across a broad technology landscape. You will help our clients navigate the complex world of modern data science, analytics, and software engineering. We'll look to you to provide guidance and perform technical development tasks to ensure AI solutions are responsibly engineered, evaluated, deployed, and maintained to support the ongoing business needs of our clients.

You will be joining a dynamic and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers who love to tackle the most challenging computational problems for our clients. We love to think creatively, build applications efficiently, and collaborate in both the ideation of solutions and the pursuit of new opportunities. Many on our team have advanced academic degrees or equivalent experience in industry.

You will spend your time on key responsibilities that include:

Researching and implementing scalable machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems that meet business requirements
Building data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions on Databricks
Evaluating, monitoring, and optimizing learning processes on Databricks to improve high-performance models, with tools like MLflow evaluation and tracing
Designing, building, and governing domain ontologies and semantic models that define business concepts, relationships, and rules for AI solutions, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data products
This position may have travel requirements as needed to engage with external clients regularly

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you will need a blend of technical expertise and interpersonal skills. Your ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver impactful solutions will be essential.

This role will work to deliver tech at speed, innovate at scale and put humans at the center. Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services focusing on more complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues surrounding emerging technology. Demonstrate technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Learn about EY and its service lines and actively assess and present ways to apply knowledge and services.

Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision
Working with teams of AI engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to deliver production-grade data engineering pipelines and AI solutions—including machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI—for clients on Databricks
Implementing product-centric AI solutions on Databricks, from discovery and roadmap definition through iterative delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable business and user outcomes
Working across design, build, deploy, and operate phases to deliver production-grade data and AI pipelines, including governed business ontologies and semantic models on Databricks, so solutions remain reliable, reusable, and aligned with client business processes
Applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch
Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem
Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving
Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform
Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures
Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote)
Working on large-scale client engagements. Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently delivering quality client services. Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making

To qualify for the role, you must have:

A Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).
3-6 years of full-time working experience in AI and/or Machine Learning
Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid, and global teams.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform using Databricks
At least two years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on Databricks, including experience with Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs.
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring.
Proficient in foundation models, generative AI, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)) and experienced with ML packages like scikit-learn and PyTorch, using Databricks tools including Agent Bricks, AI Search, Foundation Model APIs, and Unity Gateway
Experience with natural language processing and deep learning
Extensive experience in DevOps tools (Git, Azure DevOps) and AI-driven SDLC for developing, deploying, and scaling analytical solutions on Databricks, for example with Databricks Git folders, Declarative Automation Bundles, and the Databricks CLI and SDKs
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps and ML workflows on Databricks, including data ingestion, transformation, and evaluation, for example with MLflow, Models in Unity Catalog, and Model Serving
Experience with model retraining and feedback loop methodologies on Databricks, for example with Lakeflow Jobs and Databricks Feature Store
Experience evaluating and operating models and AI solutions on Databricks, including observability, monitoring, reporting, MLflow evaluation and tracing, and data quality monitoring.
Understanding of data structures, Responsible AI practices, and data modelling, and software engineering best practices
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and operations research, with proficiency in data manipulation tools (SQL, Pandas, Spark) and deep learning techniques, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake.
Excellent communication skills for conveying findings and recommendations, with willingness to travel as needed for client engagements.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Master's degree Computer Science, Mathematics, Physical Sciences, or another quantitative field
Databricks Solution Architect Champion Badge preferred
Experience in hybrid collaboration and emotional agility
A track record of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving
Knowledge of sustainability practices in technology
A deep understanding of and ability to teach concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches to apply them
Experience fine-tuning Generative AI models on Databricks, including with AI Runtime (serverless GPU)
Experience with image processing techniques and/or speech and audio processing and analysis

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are not only technically proficient but also possess the qualities of a top performer. You should be innovative, adaptable, and purpose driven by a desire to make a significant impact in the field of artificial intelligence. Your ability to collaborate effectively and communicate with clarity will set you apart as a leader in our team.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $128,400 to $192,500
Bay Area California offices – $133,600 to $200,600
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $106,900 to $176,500

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Ivanti empowers organisations to manage and secure technology smarter through our AI‑powered Ivanti Neurons platform. We help IT and Security teams reduce complexity, work proactively, and deliver better outcomes at scale for customers around the world.

About the Role

We're looking for a rare, full-stack data and AI practitioner who can operate fluidly from raw data all the way to production AI systems and the enterprise architecture that supports them. You will ingest and reason over everything from highly structured warehouse data in Snowflake to messy unstructured sources, turn it into defensible analytics, and ship agentic AI solutions that are both intelligent and ruthlessly cost-efficient. 
This is a builder-first role with real architectural ownership. You'll write the models and the agents yourself, and you'll define the reference architectures, patterns, and standards that let the rest of the organization build on top of your work. If you're equally comfortable defending a confidence interval and a system-design decision, this role is for you. 
What You'll Do

Unify structured and unstructured data.
Build pipelines that pull structured data from Snowflake (and adjacent warehouses/lakes) alongside unstructured sources — text, documents, logs, transcripts — into clean, modeling-ready datasets. 

Deliver decision-grade analytics.

Build predictive and prescriptive models.
Move beyond "what will happen" to "what should we do about it" — forecasting, propensity, and optimization/recommendation systems that drive concrete business actions. 

Engineer agentic AI systems.
Design and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that are token-efficient by design — tight context management, retrieval and caching strategies, model routing, and evaluation harnesses that keep cost and latency low without sacrificing quality. 

Architect for the enterprise.
Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and governance standards spanning data ingestion, model development, MLOps/LLMOps, security, and observability — and bring stakeholders along with clear diagrams and documentation. 

Own quality and reliability.
Establish evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for drift, accuracy, bias, safety, and cost across both classical ML and GenAI systems. 

Partner across the business.
Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. 

What You Bring (Required)

(modeling, performance, cost management) and SQL, plus experience wrangling unstructured data.

.

experience (chunking, hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evals) is strongly expected at the senior+ level. 

Architecture chops:
you can design and document end-to-end systems and patterns others build on, and defend those decisions with evidence. 

Strong Python and a software-engineering mindset (testing, version control, CI/CD). 

Excellent written and verbal communication; comfort working asynchronously in a distributed team.

Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer) and/or TOGAF
for enterprise architecture. 

Experience with inference optimization (quantization, model routing, caching, vLLM/TensorRT-style serving). 

MLOps/LLMOps tooling and platform-building experience. 

Domain experience in [your industry], and prior work owning AI strategy or build-vs-buy decisions.

A unified data foundation that combines Snowflake and unstructured sources for downstream modeling.

Title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - ML & Optimization (Secondment)

This is a secondment role for 24 months that offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact while gaining valuable experience.

About The Role

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) is the GSK function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine; its mission is to get safe, effective, consistently manufactured medicines to patients, faster. To support GSK's ambition to double new product introductions, the CMC Acceleration program is composed of three engines: the Development Engine, which fosters molecule and process development (R&D); the Tech Transfer Engine, which expedites the path from R&D to market (GSC); and the Data & Automation Engine (across CMC), which provides the foundational knowledge system feedback loop and agentification of the full CMC process.

This role will build and scale forecasting, machine learning models and optimisation solutions across CMC, on a case-by-case basis as workstreams need them. It will bring quantitative rigour to decisions such as demand and capacity forecasting, scenario evaluation and sequencing, and hand proven models to the platform and orchestration teams. We will redesign the CMC control tower as the one entry point for the full end-to-end CMC business process flow. You bring deep, hands-on AI/engineering expertise and the judgement to turn ambiguous technical problems into shipped, production-grade systems, while mentoring the engineers around you.

Key Responsibilities

PoC (Proof of Concept) / PoV (Proof of Value) / MVP (Minimum Viable Product) Delivery

Take ownership of high-priority BU (Business Unit) use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress.
Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Senior Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale.

AI-Native Engineering

Operate AI agent workflows (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery — selecting the right level of automation for each engagement.
Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course correction, and validation.

Customer Embedding & Handoff

Embed with BU teams — attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows.
Package proven use cases cleanly for the Sr. Solutions Engineer — working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns.

Governance, Standards & Coaching

Begin Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations during prototyping — so the productionisation team does not inherit governance debt.
Contribute reusable agents, prompt templates, and reference architectures to the organisation’s pattern library after each engagement.
Form and defend kill/continue recommendations at the end of each engagement — presenting clearly to BU and Enterprise AI leadership.
Coach BU engineers on AI-augmented ways of working while embedded, building BU capability alongside delivery outcomes.

Basic Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in software engineering, including full-stack application development and/or Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) solution development, with production deployment experience (minimum 10 years for G7 roles).
Experience designing, developing, and delivering software applications through the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production implementation.
Experience in Python and at least one additional programming language such as TypeScript, JavaScript, or Go.
Experience developing forecasting and time-series models, predictive Machine Learning (ML) solutions, and mathematical optimization models using techniques such as linear programming, mixed-integer programming, constraint-based optimization, or simulation.
Experience developing and deploying Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) solutions using agent-based architectures, multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model evaluation frameworks, and Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices.
Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Databricks AI Assistant, or similar solutions within software engineering workflows.

Preferred Experience

Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar), or as a Customer Engineer / Solutions Architect at a hyperscaler.
Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with GxP, validation, auditability, GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), and SOX (Sarbanes–Oxley Act).
Experience with regulatory filing documents (e.g. CTD (Common Technical Document)/eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document)) or equipment and process data to document generation.
Track record of contributing reusable engineering patterns back to a broader team.

Work Arrangement

This role offers a hybrid working model, with a mix of on-site and remote work.

Skills

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $158,400 to $264,000. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. As player needs become more varied and our experiences become more dynamic, machine learning is an increasingly important part of how we help players discover the right experiences, make better decisions in and around the game, and find fair, compelling matches.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer
in League of Legends, you will build applied machine learning systems that directly improve player experience. You will work across player and product problems through data, modeling, experimentation, launch, and iteration, partnering closely with League product, design, Insights, game engineering, and service engineering teams. You will report to the Data Engineering Director in League of Legends and operate as a deeply embedded technical partner to the game team. You will also help strengthen craft standards, knowledge sharing, and technical quality across Riot’s growing ML engineering discipline.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end ML solutions for player-facing problems across personalization, game systems, and matchmaking, from problem framing through production launch and ongoing iteration.
Set technical direction for a League ML domain and create reusable modeling, evaluation, and operating patterns that raise the bar beyond your immediate team.
Build models, recommenders, ranking systems, and decision logic that help players discover the right champions, builds, modes, content, and return paths based on their needs and context.
Develop ML approaches that improve in-game systems and matchmaking quality, balancing player experience, fairness, reliability, and operational constraints.
Partner closely with product managers, designers, analysts, and engineers to shape ambiguous opportunities into clear technical plans and shipped player-facing features.
Translate gameplay, behavioral, and product telemetry into reliable signals and evaluation frameworks.
Design and run experiments to evaluate model quality, player impact, and system tradeoffs.
Work directly with game and service engineers to integrate models into League systems and services, including helping define instrumentation and telemetry when needed.
Operate independently across multiple partner groups, driving multi-month work with limited day-to-day oversight.
Contribute to the ML engineering community at Riot through peer reviews, documentation, craft standards, and shared learnings.
Help establish robust monitoring, observability, and support practices for live ML systems as they scale.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of experience delivering ML systems in production, including 3+ years in applied modeling or ML research roles.
Evidence that your modeling choices have been adopted beyond your immediate team — whether through reusable patterns, shared architectures, or influence on how others approach problems.
History of working with complex or unconventional data sources where off-the-shelf feature engineering doesn’t apply.
Experience in production environments with interacting models, feedback loops, or systems where model behavior has downstream consequences beyond a single prediction.

Track record mentoring engineers across roles and levels; evidence of raising the bar for people around you.
Excellent written and verbal communication.

Passion for player experience, games, or creative technology.

Desired Qualifications

Experience building ML systems for games, live service products, consumer personalization, or other player-facing digital products.
Experience with matchmaking, recommendations, multi-objective optimization, or other systems that must balance competing goals.
Familiarity with causal inference, uplift modeling, contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, or other approaches useful for adaptive player experiences.

Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including fairness, safety, transparency, and operational trustworthiness.

Strong applied ML craft

Decision-making that prioritizes player value and long-term system health

jobs.title: Lead ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Job Title
: Lead ML Engineer

Team
: Technology - Enterprise Solutions

Location
: Los Angeles (Burbank)

Overview

Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph & Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions & Technology and the business units will be key.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review.
Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master-identity process to align entities across these systems.
Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program.
MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements.
Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work.
Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning.
Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs-of-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or software engineering, including 3+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic data models, or entity-resolution systems in production.
Expertise in Python and SQL, and proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow, plus scikit-learn).
Hands-on experience with at least one graph database (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) and one graph query language (Cypher/GQL, SPARQL, or Gremlin).
Robust knowledge of ontology and semantic-web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and/or property-graph modeling, with experience turning business concepts into governed, versioned models.
Proven experience with entity resolution at scale (e.g., probabilistic or embedding-based matching, Splink, Zingg, Senzing) and LLM-based information extraction from documents.
Hands-on experience with graph machine learning is required. This includes working on graph embeddings and link prediction using PyTorch Geometric or DGL. Experience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation.
Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring.
Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights-management platforms.
Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP.
Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data-product or data-mesh delivery.
Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML.
Experience with Wikidata / Wikibase, Palantir Foundry Ontology as enterprise context layers for AI agents.

About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. 🚀 Founding AI Engineer | Los Angeles (Hybrid) | $220,000 - $250,000 + Founding Equity 🚀

My client is one of the most exciting companies in Physical AI, building AI-native systems that help heavy industry make better decisions in real time. Their enterprise platform turns messy, high-stakes physical operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows, where every call moves people, equipment and capital. They’ve started in one of the toughest industrial sectors in the world, with a platform built to expand well beyond it.

Backed strongly in private funding and already selling into two of the biggest operators in their sector, they’re growing their founding engineering team at pace! 🏅

As Founding AI Engineer, you’ll architect the core intelligence of the platform in a hands-on, high-leverage builder role, moving between prompt engineering, backend systems and model optimisation. You’ll take agentic workflows from the whiteboard to production-grade systems running on real enterprise data at scale: orchestration frameworks built on LLMs, persistent memory and tool integration, plus RAG pipelines that pull high-fidelity context from fragmented data sources. You’ll build the evaluation and benchmarking suites that measure reliability, grounding and latency, and make the big calls on when to use frontier reasoning models, fine-tuned open-weight models or plain deterministic guardrails. You’ll work alongside product and engineering to turn ambiguity into working software that holds up in real operating environments.

🛠️ What you’ll bring:

7+ years building production software, knowing that AI is only as good as the infrastructure around it
2+ years shipping LLM-based products to real users in production
Deep hands-on experience with the transformer stack: embeddings, vector databases, tool-calling and context window management
Python as your power tool for building whole systems, not just experimenting in notebooks
Strong instincts for failure modes like hallucinations, API timeouts and agents stuck in loops, and how to guard against them
A security mindset: enterprise data access treated as part of the design, not an afterthought

Bonus, not required: LangGraph, LlamaIndex or PydanticAI for multi-step workflows, fine-tuning open-weight models with LoRA/QLoRA, human-in-the-loop workflows, SSO and role-based access, enterprise operations background (industrial, logistics, fintech or CRM).

✨ What makes this role unique?

🎯 Design the brain of the platform from day one, at the stage where the big decisions are still being made
🔧 Your systems run on real enterprise data in live industrial environments, not demos
🧠 Pragmatic model choices: frontier, open-weight or deterministic, whatever works best in production
📈 Founding-level ownership and close collaboration with the founders and founding team
💰 Meaningful founding equity: a real stake in the upside you help create

If you value shipping over dogma, have strong opinions on where AI creates real value and where it’s just expensive noise, and want to own the intelligence behind a live product, this is a rare chance to do it at the ground floor of Physical AI.

Note: Hybrid with regular in-person time in their Los Angeles office. Not remote. US work authorisation required, no sponsorship available.

Come and help defend the nation in cyberspace! In the Cyber Operations & Analysis Technology Group at MIT Lincoln Laboratory, we research challenging technical problems in cyber security, develop new technologies, and prototype first-of-a-kind systems. We have particular focus on enabling human operators and improving operational systems, orienting our work toward strong practical impact.

We work across a variety of cutting-edge national-security applications:

Quantifying risk posed by adversary cyber threats to key national security missions
Enhancing the cyber security and resilience of critical infrastructure and other operational technology
Protecting and defending U.S. weapon systems in cyber contested environments
Helping the nation’s cyber operators do their jobs better, faster, and at greater scale
Creating game-changing capabilities for defensive cyberspace operations

As an interdisciplinary group, we innovate by drawing insights from computer science, software engineering, data engineering, data science, artificial intelligence/machine learning, electrical engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, and allied technical fields. We collaborate with research partners across MIT, offering frequent opportunities to team and learn in new areas. If you want a career in R&D with the opportunity to have real impact on important problems, join us!

Job Overview

MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Staff provide critical multi-domain and new domain innovative research supporting the Laboratory’s national security mission. They prototype state-of-the-art technology solutions and engage across the program lifecycle, leading projects or major/multiple technical workstreams in partnership with project, program and team/Group leaders. As a Technical Staff member, you will lead complex technical efforts requiring deep expertise, sound judgment, with the ability to successfully navigate technical complexity. Depending on the level, you will lead projects, major workstreams, complex programs, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios on extraordinary technology prototype efforts and creative new ideas and approaches that support critical mission needs. Depending on the level, you will translate broad Group strategy into clearly defined research or executional deliverables. Through integrating your deep technical expertise across disciplines, you consistently drive high-quality mission outcomes.

As a successful candidate, you will connect deep and diverse technical expertise with broader Laboratory objectives, perform independent research, develop creative approaches, and translate broad strategy into executable plans. You will work across or guide multidisciplinary teams through ambiguous trade-offs; helping develop and execute programs, creating briefings and reports, and often interfacing with sponsors. You effectively support sponsor, mission-partner, and Laboratory leadership’s needs through daily or weekly technical briefings, program documentation, proposals, and may conduct advanced capability road mapping and development. You will also guide and mentor Associate Technical Staff, Assistant Technical Staff, and other technical support personnel.

Additional Job Overview Details

As an Applied AI/ML Researcher in the Cyber Operations & Analysis Technology Group, you will apply your expertise in AI/ML and cyber security to develop innovative solutions to enhance cyber resilience and the effectiveness of U.S. cyber operations. Your responsibilities will include:

Architecting, developing, and demonstrating cutting-edge data analysis and software solutions in areas where AI/ML has not been applied before.
Diving deep with real data and systems.
Collaborating with a dynamic team to rapidly acquire new skills and apply them to emerging application areas, expanding your technical capabilities and expertise.
Contributing to project leadership, technical execution, and knowledge sharing through publications, presentations, and other community engagement activities.
Participating in a culture of continuous learning and growth, with opportunities to advance as a researcher and technical expert.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Lead projects, complex programs, major technical workstreams, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios involving multidisciplinary development, analysis, prototyping, integration, testing, evaluation, and technology transition.
Apply deep technical expertise and systems-level judgment to highly complex and ambiguous problems, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, risks, stakeholder needs, and mission implications.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, sponsors, mission partners, and internal leaders to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and guide decisions and deliverables.
Assess and improve technical tools, processes, methods, documentation, execution practices, and organizational capability.

jobs.description:
What if…
you could join an organization that creates, resources, and builds life sciences companies that invent breakthrough technologies in order to transform health care and sustainability?

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Expedition Medicines is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company pioneering the emerging field of Protein Editing. At Expedition Medicines we create small molecules that edit protein structure and function to unlock presently undruggable targets and a broad array of therapeutic modalities. Our platform integrates novel small molecule chemistry and chemoproteomic discovery technologies with Machine Learning (ML) to enable generative design. Expedition Medicines is backed by Flagship Pioneering, bringing their courage, vision, and resources to guide Expedition Medicines from platform validation to patient impact. We are seeking collaborative, relentless problem solvers that share our passion for impact to join us! 

THE ROLE

Expedition is seeking a motivated and innovative (Senior) Scientist, Machine Learning
to join our team. In this role, you will play a critical role in developing, evaluating, and applying machine learning approaches that connect Expedition’s proprietary chemoproteomics data with quantum chemistry, electronic structure, and generative molecular design. The successful candidate will combine strong expertise in modern machine learning with a deep understanding of molecular representation, quantum chemistry, and computational drug discovery to drive impact across Expedition’s drug discovery programs.

This individual will contribute to the advancement of a state-of-the-art AI platform for covalent drug discovery, with a focus on linking large-scale atom-precision experimental data to physically meaningful features such as electronic structure, reactivity, and DFT-derived descriptors. A key part of the role will be applying generative models directly to active drug discovery programs in close partnership with medicinal chemistry, while developing rigorous benchmarks to evaluate model performance and guide platform improvement. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, scientifically rigorous, comfortable with hands-on data curation, and capable of independently driving projects in a fast-paced research environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop, implement, and evaluate innovative machine learning methods for connecting (macro-)molecular quantum chemical features, reactivity modeling, covalent bond formation, and proteome-wide target engagement data
Design and implement rigorous benchmarks to evaluate model performance, including retrospective, prospective, and program-relevant validation strategies
Refine, fine-tune and apply Expedition’s foundational models to our drug discovery programs in close partnership with medicinal chemistry teams, supporting compound design, prioritization, and iterative learning from experimental results
Perform hands-on data curation, quality control, and dataset construction to ensure that models are trained and evaluated on high-quality, biologically and chemically meaningful data
Develop scalable featurization and modeling pipelines for large molecular datasets, including quantum chemistry outputs, conformer ensembles, protein-ligand interaction data, covalent reactivity data, and experimental chemoproteomics data
Collaborate closely with computational, chemistry, biology, and proteomics teams to translate platform data into actionable models for discovery programs
Partner with engineering teams to productionize modeling workflows, improve data infrastructure, and build self-serve capabilities for chemistry and discovery teams
Communicate technical findings, model performance, and scientific implications clearly across cross-functional teams

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

Ph.D. in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline with 2+ years of industry experience, or M.S. degree with 6+ years of industry experience
Experience with quantum chemistry, DFT, electronic structure methods, or post-DFT descriptors.
Experience building molecular ML models including graph neural networks, geometric deep learning, equivariant architectures, diffusion models, or related approaches. Publications or preprints in, e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, bioRxiv a strong plus.
Experience applying generative models, molecular design models, or active learning workflows to drug discovery or chemistry optimization problems
Experience working closely with medicinal chemistry teams to prioritize compounds, interpret model outputs, and incorporate experimental feedback into model development
Experience developing rigorous model evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and validation strategies for molecular ML or scientific machine learning applications and an ability to curate, clean, integrate, and analyze complex, large-scale scientific datasets from multiple sources
Proficiency with Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, DGL, or related tools and cheminformatics and molecular modeling toolkits such as RDKit, ORCA, Gaussian, Q-Chem, or related software is preferred
Experience with scalable data processing, model training, and analysis workflows for large scientific datasets
Experience with covalent chemistry, reaction modeling, structure-based design, or chemoproteomics data is a plus
Ability to work closely with experimental scientists and translate biological and chemical questions into computational strategies
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

LOCATION: 
Cambridge, MA

ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. jobs.description:
About Sluicebox

Sluicebox builds AI systems that help manufacturers understand, report and improve the environmental impact of complex products, starting with electronics and carbon. Manufacturers use us to scale work that is manual, expert-heavy and hard to trust: carbon/LCA analysis, supplier data collection, compliance responses and product sustainability decisions.
The role

A product-minded, backend-strong software engineer who builds reliable AI-powered product systems. This is not an ML research role.
In practice: LLM pipelines that map messy bills of materials to emission factors, agents that collect and check supplier data, and the evals that tell us when either one is wrong. Discovery and delivery are both part of the job, including real time with customers and their data.
What you'll do

Own ambiguous product and technical problems end to end, from customer need to shipped and iterated solution.
Build backend-heavy systems for complex product, component, supplier and sustainability data.
Design AI workflows with LLMs, agents, structured context, tool use and evaluation loops.
Improve the accuracy, explainability and reliability of AI outputs.
Work across the stack when needed, including React product surfaces.

What we're looking for

A strong backend engineer with excellent product judgment: systems, data models, APIs, relational databases.
You have shipped an LLM or agent system that real users depend on, not a demo, and can show how you knew it was working.
You reason about evaluation, quality, reliability, latency and cost.
You own problems without a fully specified roadmap or PM-written tickets.
TypeScript/React, Python/Postgres, Kubernetes/AWS, or able to ramp up quickly.

How we work

Remote-first. Based in Austin, Texas or anywhere else in the United States. We work US Central time. The team meets in person roughly once a quarter.
Pay

USD 130,000 - 170,000 base, plus equity.
Hiring process

CV screen, motivation and fit, live technical interview, take-home with a live review, then the founders.
How to apply

Apply at https://sluicebox.ai/careers/senior-ai-product-engineer#apply with your CV and one example of an LLM or agent system you shipped to production, and what it changed for users.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Government
jobs.description:
About The Team

The mission of the Applied AI Engineering team is to enable the secure and impactful implementation of GenAI solutions. We serve as technical thought partners and trusted advisors to our clients, ideating high-value use cases and providing the hands-on guidance necessary to drive projects into production. In this role within the Government team, you will empower agencies to evolve their operations through automated content synthesis, advanced search capabilities, and bespoke applications leveraging our latest foundational technologies and models.

About The Role

We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our public sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies (federal, state, and local), policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll then partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll take a holistic view of their needs and design an architecture using the OpenAI API and other services to maximize customer value. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, and Product teams.

This role is based in Washington, DC. We offer relocation support to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Deeply embed with our most sophisticated public sector customers as the technical lead, serving as their technical thought partner to ideate and build novel applications on our API and other OpenAI foundational technologies like Codex.
Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify the best applications of GenAI in their industry and to build/qualify a comprehensive backlog to support their AI roadmap.
Intervene directly to accelerate customer time to value through building hands-on prototypes and/or by delivering impactful strategic guidance, often in collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.
Forge and manage relationships with our customers’ and implementation partners’ leadership and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and scale of their applications.
Contribute to our open-source developer and enterprise resources.
Scale the Deployment Engineering function through sharing knowledge, codifying best practices, and publishing notebooks to our internal and external repositories.
Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Research teams.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Hold an active TS/SCI clearance
Bring 7+ years of technical consulting (or equivalent) experience with public sector customers (U.S. federal preferred), bridging technical teams and senior stakeholders.
Have successfully led GenAI or traditional ML implementations for government agencies in close collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.
Understand network and cloud architecture, including experience with on-premise deployments.
Are an effective and polished communicator who can translate business and technical topics to all audiences.
Have industry experience in programming languages like Python, Go, or Typescript.
Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done.
Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed.
Are an effective, high throughput operator who can drive multiple concurrent projects and prioritize ruthlessly.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Full stack AI Application Engineer to design and implement advanced agentic AI systems. In this role, you'll build production-ready AI agents that can reason across multiple steps You'll work with state of the art frameworks to create pipelines that combine LLM-based reasoning, knowledge grounding, and multi-agent orchestration. This is a high-impact role where you'll partner with product and engineering teams to design workflows into reliable, scalable agentic solutions for real-world use cases.

What Will You Accomplish

Build Agentic Systems – Implement multi-step reasoning agents. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and integrations to tools, databases, and APIs.

Infrastructure & MLOps: Deploy models and pipeline workers into resilient, asynchronous microservices (e.g., Kafka/RabbitMQ, Celery, Ray, Docker, Kubernetes) with latency, throughput, and privacy safeguards (PII masking, encryption at rest/in transit).
Deploy & Evolve – Deliver production-grade agentic AI workflows on cloud platforms, monitor and evaluate agent performance, and continuously fine-tune for quality and efficiency.

What Will You Bring

Proficiency in developing backend services using Java (Spring / Spring Boot).
Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration and supervisor patterns.
Knowledge of RAG pipelines, memory management, and evaluation of agent performance.
Hands-on experience with OCR systems, layout analysis (e.g., LayoutLM, Donut, Nougat), or Vision-Language Models (VLMs) applied to document extraction.
Experience designing custom evaluation metrics for reasoning steps, tool use correctness, and RAG pipeline performance.
Ability to balance automatic evaluation with human-in-the-loop evaluation for complex workflows.
Experience with agentic architecture, including agent frameworks, tool-calling protocols and planning/execution patterns.
Knowledge of reinforcement learning, planning algorithms, or autonomous reasoning.

Proven experience leading and contributing hands-on to AI/ML engineering and operations in large-scale production environments.

Deep understanding of AI model lifecycle management, distributed systems, and integration of applications powered by artificial intelligence into customer-facing platforms.

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today's EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals.

Job Description

Seeking an experienced Senior AI Solutions Engineer to design, develop, integrate, deploy, secure, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions within an enterprise Information Technology environment.

The successful candidate will work across the full AI solution lifecycle, transforming customer and mission requirements into secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable AI-enabled capabilities. This position will work closely with customers, software developers, cloud and infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity personnel, data professionals, and other technical stakeholders.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance AI-powered applications and enterprise solutions.
Develop solutions utilizing large language models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and other modern AI technologies.
Work with customers and technical stakeholders to identify use cases, understand mission and business requirements, and translate those requirements into effective AI solutions.
Integrate AI capabilities into new and existing enterprise applications, systems, data sources, and business workflows.
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data and knowledge sources.
Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, context-management strategies, and other techniques designed to improve AI solution accuracy, reliability, and usefulness.
Develop, consume, and manage APIs and services supporting communication between AI models, applications, databases, and enterprise systems.
Design and implement data ingestion, transformation, indexing, search, retrieval, and processing capabilities supporting AI solutions.
Provision, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure supporting AI applications and workloads.
Implement identity, authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, and other security mechanisms protecting AI systems and information.
Collaborate with cybersecurity personnel to identify vulnerabilities, implement appropriate security controls, and support applicable cybersecurity requirements.
Implement safeguards designed to protect sensitive information and reduce the risk of unauthorized access, disclosure, or inappropriate use of data.
Support Responsible AI practices, including appropriate consideration of accuracy, transparency, privacy, security, reliability, and human oversight.
Evaluate AI models, platforms, frameworks, tools, and architectural approaches based on technical requirements, mission needs, security considerations, performance, and cost.
Evaluate and test AI-generated results for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and reliability.
Develop methods for measuring and improving AI solution performance and effectiveness.
Monitor application and model performance, availability, reliability, usage, resource consumption, and operating costs.
Optimize model selection, API consumption, token utilization, compute resources, storage, and other cloud services to improve performance and control costs.
Troubleshoot application, model, integration, infrastructure, data, and performance issues throughout the AI solution lifecycle.
Participate in source control, code review, testing, configuration management, CI/CD, and DevSecOps processes.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution architecture, data flows, interfaces, configurations, security controls, deployment procedures, operating procedures, and troubleshooting information.
Support proofs of concept and prototypes and assist in transitioning successful solutions into secure, supportable production capabilities.
Remain current on emerging AI technologies, large language models, cloud services, cybersecurity risks, Responsible AI practices, and industry developments.
Communicate complex AI and technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

5 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; 0 years experience with PhD or Juris Doctorate in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance for the duration of employment.
Be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) clearance if required by the customer or assigned duties.

Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI

OpenAI or comparable commercial/open-source model platforms
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

AI agents and agentic workflows
Vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise search
Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or comparable programming languages
REST APIs, web services, and application integration

Cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

SQL, NoSQL, and other enterprise data technologies
Data ingestion, transformation, indexing, and retrieval

Git, GitHub, or comparable source-control platforms
CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
Application and cloud security
AI security and data-protection practices
Model evaluation, testing, monitoring, and observability
AI governance and Responsible AI practices
Performance and cloud-cost optimization
Development and deployment of enterprise AI applications
