Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid, and global teams.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform using Databricks
At least two years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on Databricks, including experience with Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs.
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring.

Experience with natural language processing and deep learning

jobs.description:
Help shape the future of AI-powered customer experience in iGaming and Online sports betting as the technical lead of Raphie's engineering team.

About Raphie

Raphie is a leading provider of AI-powered customer service tools built for the iGaming and Online Sports Betting sector. We partner with global operators to deliver intelligent, automated support that improves player experience and operational efficiency.

Our mission is to transform how iGaming and online sports betting businesses engage with their players through fast, scalable, industry-specific AI. We're growing our U.S. engineering team and need a hands-on lead to set the technical bar as we scale.

The Role

This is a player-coach role: about 60-70% hands-on IC work and 30-40% technical leadership. You'll run the engineering team's day to day alongside the Senior Product Manager and CTO, so delivery stays predictable while you keep shipping the hardest parts of the platform yourself.

You'll own:
Technical direction and architecture for Raphie's AI platform and multi-agent capabilities
Day-to-day engineering execution: sprint delivery, code quality, unblocking the team
Raphie's AI evaluation and quality strategy across client deployments
Growing the team through mentorship, hiring and clear engineering standards

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership
Lead the team's daily engineering work: break down scope, assign work, unblock engineers and keep sprints on track
Own architecture decisions and technical trade-offs, and write them up so the team and stakeholders can follow the reasoning
Set and enforce engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability and documentation
Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and regular 1:1 technical guidance
Coordinate with external development partners so their work meets Raphie's standards and roadmap
Help hire engineers: shape interview loops, run technical assessments, raise the bar
Act as the escalation point for production incidents, and lead root-cause analysis and follow-up

Platform Development (Hands-On)
Design, build and ship core platform features from scoping through production
Lead the expansion into new capability areas: multi-agent orchestration, new channel types (chat, email, voice, social), automation workflows and AI-driven features
Work with the Senior PM and CTO to turn product priorities into well-scoped, sequenced technical plans
Improve platform architecture, reliability and scalability as deployment volume grows

Client Integration & AI Engineering
Own integration architecture between Raphie and client systems (PAMs, CRMs, ticketing, chat, data APIs)
Lead prompt engineering and model selection for client deployments, and set reusable patterns the team can apply consistently
Build reusable SDKs, connectors and tooling that cut onboarding time for new operators
Handle the most complex technical problems with Product and Client Solutions

AI Evaluation & Quality
Own Raphie's evaluation framework: automated and human-in-the-loop testing for accuracy, tone, latency and compliance
Define the quality metrics and release gates that decide when AI changes go live, including the move from copilot to full automation
Build monitoring and dashboards for AI performance across client deployments
Lead testing of new model versions and agent architectures, and turn the findings into roadmap decisions with the Senior PM

About You

You're a senior engineer who still loves to build, and you've started leading teams without leaving the code behind. You're comfortable owning outcomes, making calls with incomplete information, and raising the level of the people around you.

Requirements

6-7+ years of full-stack engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a tech lead, staff or team lead role
Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered products to production (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), including agents, tool use or RAG
Deep fluency with AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar), plus a track record of raising the team's productivity with them. This is a must-have.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js; Ruby on Rails experience a plus
Proven experience designing APIs, data pipelines and system integrations at scale
Experience building or owning LLM evaluation frameworks (offline evals, LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop QA)
Track record of mentoring engineers and running team delivery (sprint planning, code review, incident response)
Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to engineers, product leaders and clients
Comfortable leading distributed teams across time zones, including external partners

Bonus / Nice-to-Have

Experience in gaming, sports betting, fintech or other regulated, high-volume transactional industries
Experience with multi-agent systems or conversational AI at scale
Observability, experiment tracking or LLM ops tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, Datadog, etc.)
Early-stage startup experience, especially as one of the first engineering leads

Why Join Raphie

Lead engineering at a company redefining AI-driven customer service in iGaming and Online Sports Betting
Real ownership: your architecture decisions and standards shape the platform and the team
A mix of hands-on building and leadership, with a clear path to Engineering Manager or Head of Engineering as the team grows
Work directly with the CTO, Product and client teams on high-impact problems
Competitive U.S. salary, performance incentives and potential equity
Fully remote within the U.S.

How to Apply

If you're excited to build and lead the future of AI-powered customer experience, we'd love to hear from you. Apply directly via LinkedIn.

At Interclypse, you will find more than a career – you will discover a vibrant ecosystem where your talents are celebrated, your ideas are embraced, and your potential is achieved. jobs.description:
About Us

Calibr-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines, a division of Scripps Research, is a first-of-its-kind, nonprofit translational research institute dedicated to creating the next generation of medicines. Calibr-Skaggs was founded on the principle that the creation of new medicines can be accelerated by pairing world-class biomedical research with state-of-the-art drug discovery and development capabilities. Scripps Research is ranked one of the most influential institutions in the world for its impact on innovation. Our educational and training programs mold talented and committed students and postdocs into leading edge scientists. Leveraging the unique scientific environment of Scripps Research, impacting translational sciences, Calibr-Skaggs has created a portfolio of drug candidates, and is shaping a new paradigm for advancing nonprofit biomedical research to impact patients while re-investing in further innovative research. We expand basic knowledge in the biosciences and use these fundamental advancements to develop profound innovations that improve wellbeing. Calibr-Skaggs’ drug development portfolio spans a broad range of human diseases, including cancer, autoimmunity and inflammatory diseases, metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, infectious and neglected diseases, as well as age-related and degenerative diseases. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team. This position is based on site at our La Jolla campus.

POSITION TITLE:
Research Scientist - Computational Peptide Chemistry

Position Summary

We are seeking a Research Scientist - Computational Peptide Chemistry to develop and apply machine learning and generative AI approaches for the de novo design and optimization of peptide therapeutics. The role will focus on leveraging diffusion models, protein language models, and physics-based methods to discover novel peptide binders, improve potency and selectivity, and optimize developability properties. You will work closely with interdisciplinary teams of computational scientists, medicinal chemists, and biologists to advance peptide therapeutics, including long-acting peptides and conjugates, toward preclinical development. This is an on site position based on our La Jolla, CA campus.

Responsibilities

Develop and apply generative AI approaches, including diffusion models and protein language models, for de novo peptide design and potency optimization of existing leads.
Design and optimize linear, stapled, and macrocyclic peptides, incorporating non-natural amino acids, backbone modifications, and half-life extension strategies.
Develop machine learning models to predict peptide binding affinity, selectivity, proteolytic stability, solubility, and aggregation.
Integrate generative models with structure prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and free energy calculations to guide peptide design and optimization.
Leverage structural, sequence, and experimental assay data to train, validate, and benchmark predictive and generative models.
Develop automated workflows for peptide generation, virtual screening, multi-parameter optimization, and candidate prioritization.
Collaborate with synthetic chemists and biologists to interpret SAR, prioritize designs, and iteratively improve models using experimental feedback.

Requirements

BS, MS, or PhD in Computational Chemistry, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
Minimum of 1 year of relevant research experience.
Experience developing or applying machine learning models for small molecule, peptide or protein design and/or property prediction.
Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Familiarity with peptide chemistry, protein structure, and molecular interactions.
Strong analytical, programming, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.

Additional Preferences

Experience with structure-based generative design tools (e.g., RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, AlphaFold) for molecular or peptide design.
Experience with peptide potency optimization, binding affinity prediction, and multi-objective molecular optimization.
Knowledge of peptide modifications, including non-canonical amino acids, cyclization, stapling, lipidation, and half-life extension strategies.
Experience with molecular simulations, docking, free energy calculations, or enhanced sampling (e.g., Schrödinger, GROMACS, AMBER, Rosetta).
Familiarity with peptide synthesis constraints, oral bioavailability, and developability optimization.

Physical Requirements

This position works in a laboratory environment. Further details of the physical requirements of established essential functions for this position will be addressed/discussed during the interview process.

Compensation

The expected hiring range for this position is $77,000 - $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Consideration will be given to experience that exceeds the listed requirements.

Comprehensive Benefits Include

Eligibility for retirement plans with employer contribution.
Full suite of Health and Welfare plans including three medical plan options (including an HSA available option), dental, vision, life insurance, disability, EAP and more.
Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical/Dependent Care).
Competitive vacation and sick leave policies.
Free, on-site Counseling Center which provides confidential counseling services to benefits-eligible employees and their family members.
Free, on-site parking.

jobs.title: Lead/Senior Research Scientist (Agentic RL)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release.

The research team trains and evaluates the Thomson models to perform at a frontier level for professional workflows. We work with a range of large open-weight models and use continual learning to improve them comprehensively, rather than pre-training from scratch or doing narrow fine-tuning. The training pipeline includes value alignment, data-centric mid-training on curated proprietary data, DPO, and reinforcement learning (RL) for product-ready tasks. The evaluation group builds the measurement side: expert-annotated legal and tax benchmarks, agentic systems, and human preference studies with subject-matter experts. We regularly publish work that comes out of our training and evaluation efforts.

We Are Hiring Scientists At Senior And Lead Level Across Three Areas Of Emphasis. In Your Application, Please Tell Us Which One Or Two Fit You Best

Agentic reinforcement learning: post-training for agentic behaviour (planning, long-context reasoning, tool calls, long-horizon tasks inside real agent harnesses), multi-turn RL and policy optimisation, reward modelling and training-signal design.
Model training: continued pre-training and post-training of open-weight models, DPO and RL, training data and reward design, forgetting and replay in continued pre-training.
Model evaluation: benchmarks and targeted evaluations for complex legal and professional workflows, LLM-as-a-judge and rubric design, human preference studies with legal experts, and evaluation results that inform training objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Design new benchmarks, training datasets, rewards and training signals to improve the Thomson model family, including for tasks where ground truth is scarce, delayed or partly subjective.
Design rigorous experiments and diagnostics (for example ablations) that separate algorithmic effects from data, reward and system artefacts, and carry results into production models.
Build and extend the evaluation suite to understand Thomson's strengths and weaknesses, and use the results to inform training objectives and technical trade-offs.
Work hand in hand with Research Engineers on our large-scale training and evaluation infrastructure, and with subject-matter experts in law, tax and other professional domains.
Coordinate with product teams and other model consumers to understand adoption requirements and drive integration.
Publish regularly at top-tier ML and NLP venues and represent Thomson Reuters Labs in the research community.
At Lead level: own a research agenda, turn emerging methods into a roadmap for our models, and mentor scientists and engineers.

Required Qualifications

PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on LLM post-training and/or evaluation experience, preferably at frontier model development scale, using Python and PyTorch.
A track record of research impact you can point to: publications at top-tier venues (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM) and/or work that shaped an LLM development cycle.
Experience working closely with researchers and cross-functional stakeholders, including subject-matter experts, to turn ideas into practical training or evaluation assets.
Excellent written and oral communication, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
For Lead level: 3+ years of research experience after the PhD, a record of leading a research agenda to published or deployed results, and of mentoring or supervising researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with RL post-training frameworks (NeMo-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL) or evaluation frameworks (Inspect, lm-evaluation-harness).
Experience designing LLM-as-a-judge or rubric-based reward and evaluation pipelines and measuring their reliability.
Experience with Mixture-of-Experts or long-context models.
Experience with law, tax or other professional, non-verifiable domains, particularly grounding and citation.
Experience in experimental design and best practices for working with human data.
Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale.

Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Carrix is seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy production applications using Generative AI, frontier LLMs, and agentic AI architectures.

The role combines software engineering, AI/ML, cloud technologies, and enterprise integration to develop multi-agent systems, reusable AI tools and platforms, MCP tools, RAG pipelines, and Python-based services. This is not a traditional data science or model-training role. We are looking for an AI engineer who knows how to use modern foundation models to build real applications. The right candidate should be comfortable moving between an LLM, agent workflow, MCP tool, Python service, RAG pipeline and understand how these pieces come together in a reliable production system.

Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI applications, including agentic and multi-agent systems using frontier LLMs.
Develop agent workflows incorporating reasoning, planning, routing, tool execution, memory, state management, parallel execution, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Build reusable MCP servers, tools, APIs, and Python-based services that connect AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, and internal applications.
Develop RAG and knowledge retrieval solutions using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, reranking, and related techniques.
Evaluate and integrate foundation models, making engineering decisions around model selection, prompting, structured outputs, context management, and multi-model architectures.
Establish evaluation, testing, observability, and monitoring for AI applications, including response quality, grounding, hallucination, tool execution, latency, token consumption, and task completion.
Implement security and access controls for AI systems, including identity and permissions, secrets management, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and safe agent execution; partner with Cybersecurity on AI threat modeling and security requirements.
Partner with Enterprise Applications, Cybersecurity, Data, Infrastructure, and business teams to translate business requirements into AI solutions and move use cases from proof-of-concept through production in accordance with enterprise architecture and responsible AI governance standards.
Create reusable engineering components, patterns, reference implementations, CI/CD pipelines, technical documentation, and runbooks to support broader AI development and ongoing operations.
Evaluate and support local or on-premises AI inference workloads as needed, including GPU-based model serving and production deployment patterns.
Provide coaching, knowledge transfer, and ongoing support for the operation and maintenance of key deployed systems.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
5+ years of software, data, machine learning, or related engineering, including at least 2 years developing Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Proven success taking AI or LLM applications from prototype through production in an enterprise environment
Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Anthropic Claude, Microsoft agent 365, Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock
Strong Python development skills, including production APIs, backend services, and system integrations.
Hands-on expertise with agentic AI architectures, including agent workflows, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
Deep understanding of RAG and knowledge retrieval architectures, including embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and reranking.
Proficiency working with frontier foundation models such as OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, or comparable models.

We’re at a pivotal moment for AI and energy. Demand for compute is skyrocketing, but power constraints are becoming a critical bottleneck. Emerald AI sits at the intersection of these two worlds, enabling AI data centers to scale without overwhelming the grid.

Our Emerald Conductor software platform makes data centers flexible and responsive, allowing them to adjust power usage dynamically. This unlocks massive AI growth without major new infrastructure, while also strengthening the grid and supporting the expansion of renewable energy.

.

About The Role

Emerald AI is building the world's first power flexible managed cloud infrastructure. We are hiring a senior infrastructure engineer to architect and stand up our managed cloud services from end to end. The work covers the platform, the control plane, and the customer experience that together make up a managed AI cloud.

The right person has done this before. They have built or served as a core early engineer on a managed cloud or AI platform, whether at a GPU cloud, an internal machine learning platform run at scale, a hyperscaler AI service, or a HPC research computing center operated as a service. Experience building billing, metering, or FinOps pipelines for services that charge by usage.

Description

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect a Senior Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Applied Scientist on this team you will:

Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
Raise the science bar: mentor scientists and engineers, review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

About The Team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

The Research team at HUMAN is eager to protect the internet, and is passionate about innovating and winning against our attackers. As the ‘mind’ behind our products, we demand ourselves to bring our best and never stop learning attitude, eventually making our products’ trillions decisions per day as accurate as possible.

Our group includes data scientists, detection engineers, and security researchers, working together towards reaching our goals and for mutual personal development. We’re currently looking for a talented Senior Research Scientist to join Enterprise Research + Detection on the Detection Automation squad, reporting directly to the Chief Scientist and working closely with the Senior Director for Research+Detection for Sightline, the VP of Customer Success and Director of COPS, and VP of GTM.

What You'll Do

Research and implement innovative ways to identify and block malicious activity, then turn those methods into automated systems that run without a standing human in the loop.
Build and own internal tooling and services that enroll, refresh, and quality-check detections across customers, so protection ships as a normal part of the product rather than a long manual process.
Work with huge amounts of historical and live traffic data — warehouses, queries, and production write-paths — to find solutions to complex problems and to prove that a change is safe before it lands.
Partner closely with customer success, sales engineering, engineering, product, the rest of Research + Detection so research findings become reliable production behavior, with failures visible and guardrails in place.
Take part in a global core team of researchers and data scientists, with real opportunity to initiate work, reduce cost and toil, and raise detection quality.
Over time, extend that same automation mindset to how Research handles detection operations and escalations: shared tooling, agents where they help, and global solutions that scale to current and future customers.

Who You Are

8+ years across large-scale data analysis, software engineering, tooling and process automation, and security research — you have shipped production systems, not only analyses.
Strong Python and SQL; comfortable owning warehouse-backed services (Snowflake or equivalent), internal apps, and the glue that takes a decision from query to written config.
A builder who removes operational queues. You have automated a recurring analyst/operator workflow so the happy path no longer needs a ticket, a checklist, or a human-in-the-loop.
A researcher mindset: you form a hypothesis, backtest on historical data, measure FP/FN, and only then write to production. Correctness, cost, and performance are equally important to you.
Knowledge of how the internet works (HTTP, clients, scanning, how traffic actually shows up in logs and warehouses). Familiarity with application-layer attacks, bot or vulnerability signatures, or threat-intelligence collection is a plus.
Proven record of solving messy, high-volume data problems — ingest, quality, scoring, and making failures visible instead of silent.
Strong sense of ownership: you find ways to do things better, faster, and cheaper, and you hold the quality bar when the easy path is “just dump more configs.”
A great team player — open, transparent, and effective with CS, SEs, support teams, and other researchers.
Based in the United States on Eastern Time, able to work closely with our Customer Success, Go-to Market teams, and with a global Research team.
Great motivation to keep learning, and a desire to influence the product rather than sit beside it.

What Will Set You Apart

You have built or extended internet-scale crawling, scanning, or threat-intelligence platforms, and you care about what happens when a detection is wrong.
You have automated signature or detector generation under a real false-positive constraint — ship fast, do not spray noisy rules onto production traffic.
You have stood up internal operator tooling (dashboards, Slack entry points, plan/state machines) that non-engineers can actually use.
You are at home with streaming and orchestration (Kafka, Airflow, Kubernetes) and with writing production services, not only notebooks.
You have taken something from 0→1: a system that did not exist, used by real operators, with an explicit fail/success state.
You treat “the human reviews every output” as a phase to exit, not as the product.

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

The ETS Research Institute invites applications for a Senior Research Scientist
position to lead and contribute to a research agenda focused on schooling, human capital development, workforce readiness, and economic mobility in an AI-enabled world. The position will be housed in the Center for Policy Research, a new initiative at ETS dedicated to providing policymakers the research evidence they need to improve education and workforce systems at scale. The Center’s research agenda focuses on the development of foundational skills (e.g., literacy, numeracy, etc.), durable skills (e.g., communication, critical thinking, etc.), and AI literacy in K-12 settings; college-to-career pathways; credentials of value; job training; upskilling; and adult learning.

Particular areas of interest include (1) understanding and measuring the skills and capabilities that drive success in education and labor markets, including how advances in AI are reshaping skill demand, workforce readiness, and pathways to opportunity, and (2) generating evidence on the effectiveness of educational and workforce development pathways, including competency-based education (CBE), career and technical education (CTE), and other approaches designed to promote skill acquisition, employment, earnings growth, and long-term economic mobility.

We seek quantitative scientists to work in a dynamic research environment sitting at the intersection of innovative policy research methods, state-of-the art large scale assessment data, world-class measurement science, and policy impact. Scientists in the Center will directly interface with educational and workforce stakeholders at the federal, state, and local level to scope out policy challenges and produce applied research that can help address those challenges. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience directly collaborating with policymakers to identify evidence-based solutions. The successful candidate will join a growing team advancing ETS’s research agenda focused on policies and programs that impart the knowledge and skills that learners of all ages need for the workforce of the future. The job is based in ETS’ Washington, DC office. Scientists in the Center are expected to represent ETS in the activities and functions of the city’s vibrant policy ecosystem.

Conduct and publish rigorous policy research on education and workforce systems, including K-12, postsecondary, and career pathways, using causal inference methods (e.g., regression discontinuity, difference-in-differences) and other quantitative designs.
Investigate how skills, competencies, credentials, and educational experiences predict educational attainment, employment, earnings growth, productivity, workforce participation, and economic mobility.
Lead the development, evaluation, and translation of research frameworks that inform state and federal education policy, with attention to systems-level change.
Lead internal research teams and collaborations with external partners – including state education agencies, school districts, foundations, and research organizations – on policy analysis and field-building initiatives.

WHAT WE OFFER

More than a career. A calling. A community. A purpose.

Document solution designs and technical decisions, staying current on emerging AI trends and best practices to support knowledge-sharing across teams.

AI Solution Design
Technical Acumen

Prioritization and Delivery
Collaboration
Communication

Working knowledge of AI solutions and technologies, and technical knowledge of AI solution design, architecture, and implementation, with the ability to apply them to solve real business problems.
Ability to work effectively with both business-side stakeholders and engineering/technical teams, serving as a bridge between the two.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI, or Anthropic APIs.
Experience with SQL and/or a scripting language such as Python.

Experience in healthcare, insurance, or a nonprofit/faith-based environment preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field preferred.

jobs.title: Architect Lead - AI & Agentic Systems
jobs.description:
Discover your potential. Build your legacy.

Go the distance with Capital Group

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.

The Role

As a Lead Architect – AI & Agentic Systems, you’ll define and build the AI architecture that shapes how Capital Group serves clients and empowers associates across sales, marketing, product, and client engagement. You’ll set the target state for Agentic AI, including multi-agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, evaluation, and guardrails, and you’ll be responsible for prototyping reference implementations, writing and reviewing code, and working side by side with engineering teams to move high-value use cases from experimentation into governed production. As a hands-on technical leader, you’ll help Capital Group own what matters most — the agent orchestration layer, the data and knowledge layer, and the associate and client experience — while integrating third-party agents and enterprise SaaS platforms where they deliver value faster. Your work will ensure our AI investments compound into reusable enterprise capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

The Team

You’ll join the AI & Data Architecture team, led by our Principal AI & Data Architect and working closely with business, product, engineering, data governance, risk, and enterprise AI and platform leaders across the firm. The team defines target state architecture for AI and data across our sales, marketing, product, and client engagement capabilities, writes the reference architectures and decision records that guide delivery, and works hands-on with engineering teams to prove patterns before they scale. Together, you’ll help leaders move AI and data initiatives from promising pilots to trusted, governed, reusable enterprise capabilities.

Your Impact

Shape target state AI architecture and roadmaps, including the interim states needed to move AI solutions from pilot to production at scale, aligned with enterprise AI platform direction and business priorities.
Apply clear build, buy, and partner principles — build where proprietary data creates competitive advantage, buy or partner for standard capabilities — and assess opportunities against business value and readiness, including data availability, integration complexity, and change impact.
Serve as solution architect for high-impact AI programs, producing architecture blueprints, points of view, product requirements, and architecture decision records that carry decisions through delivery and architecture review.
Design and build multi-agent solutions spanning orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, human-in-the-loop review, and deterministic workflow controls, running on governed production agent runtimes such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
Ground agents in trusted enterprise knowledge through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and GraphRAG patterns that combine vector search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic layers.
Define how agents securely reach enterprise tools and data, including CRM, marketing and content platforms, enterprise data platforms, identity, and compliance systems, through APIs, events, Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability.
Establish a resilient, multi-provider model strategy, including model selection and routing, capacity and failover across cloud providers, and cost and latency management.
Operationalize LLMOps and AgentOps practices, including evaluation harnesses for individual agents and orchestrators, golden datasets, prompt and model versioning, observability, and feedback loops.
Embed Responsible AI by design through guardrails, grounding and fact-checking, access-aware retrieval, privacy and PII controls, auditability, and appropriate human oversight.
Define and maintain reference architectures, AI standards, and reusable agent components — tool and connector templates, evaluation and guardrail frameworks, and agent naming, tagging, and observability standards — so that agents and tools are reusable across use cases.
Evaluate AI models, vendors, and platforms on architectural fit, security, extensibility, cost, and long-term strategic value, and translate a fast-moving market into pragmatic guidance.
Conduct architecture reviews and provide hands-on guidance, troubleshooting, and coaching that raises the engineering bar for AI solutions.

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; an advanced degree in AI, machine learning, or data science is a plus.
10+ years of architecture and engineering experience in large organizations, including 3+ years designing and delivering machine learning, generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions into production.
A proven track record of defining target state architectures and transformation roadmaps and carrying them through delivery.
Hands-on experience building Agentic AI solutions with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent, foundation model platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, and tool-calling and interoperability protocols such as MCP.
Deep expertise in RAG architectures, including embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking, vector stores, and knowledge graphs.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and modern application, API, integration, and event-driven architecture, including cloud-native services on AWS, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
Practical experience with evaluation, observability, and quality engineering for LLM and agent applications in production.
Understanding of AI governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, and model risk, including prompt injection, data leakage, and frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, and an understanding of how data quality, semantics, and lineage determine AI outcomes.
Strong strategic judgment and executive communication, with the ability to influence technical direction across teams, and to lead and inspire architects and engineers, particularly in ambiguous environments.
A background in financial services or asset management, particularly sales, marketing, or distribution, is a plus.

What You’ll Get

When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. And as a privately held firm built for the long term, we offer the opportunity and support to build a career that lasts.

Azure AI Engineer Senior Consultant

Job Description

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture.  We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success
. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Consulting Senior Consultant to join our growing Application, Development & Engineering team.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates.  At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies. 

What Will Help You Be Successful

You enjoy Azure cloud and software engineering.
You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to Azure AI, including the latest trends and developments. 
You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.
You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.
You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members. 
You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.
You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Experience with or understanding of:
Azure AI Foundry
Azure OpenAI Service
Generative AI
retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
agentic AI development.
Hands-on experience developing AI agents or multi-agent solutions using orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LangGraph.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool-enabled agent architectures.
Experience with Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Storage, or related Azure services.
Experience with vector databases and enterprise knowledge retrieval architectures, including RAG architectures that securely connect large language models with enterprise data.
Design, develop, and deploy generative AI solutions, copilots, intelligent agents, and multi-agent workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Services, and Azure AI Search.
Develop AI applications and services using Python, C#, .NET, JavaScript, or TypeScript, along with APIs, microservices, and serverless and cloud-native Azure services.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, vector stores, and business workflows, including Microsoft Copilot capabilities.
Apply prompt engineering, context engineering, function/tool calling, embeddings, and vector search to improve AI application performance.
Build evaluation frameworks, guardrails, monitoring, and observability into AI solutions, and implement secure development practices addressing identity, access, data protection, content safety, Responsible AI, and AI governance.
Develop and maintain CI/CD and LLMOps/MLOps processes using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or MLflow.
Collaborate with client stakeholders, architects, data scientists, engineers, security teams, and business leaders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Participate in client workshops, technical design sessions, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and production implementations.
Evaluate emerging Microsoft AI capabilities and recommend technologies and architectural approaches based on client requirements.
Develop reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and technical assets supporting Protiviti's Microsoft and AI capabilities.
Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network. 
Ability to translate and communicate challenges to client personnel, including executives. 
Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.  

Your Educational And Professional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or-related field).
2+ years working in professional services or industry.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio and Access.
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate required. 
Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate preferred. 

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

$105,000.00 - $174,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

jobs.description:
Overview

Live the experience
. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where our passion for better solutions
drives us and is core to who we are.

We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no-holds-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN MAKE:

Ulta is seeking an Architect, Martech Agentic Engineering to transform how Martech builds and operates software and data products by making agentic engineering practical, effective, safe, and reusable. This hands-on technical leader will establish the agentic engineering operating model, practices, tooling, reusable capabilities and guardrails that make AI-enabled engineering effective, safe and scalable. Operating as a center for enablement, the role will pioneer new ways of working and then embed those capabilities across delivery teams through a hub-and-spoke model.

YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Define — Define the technical vision, architecture, tooling strategy, standards, and operating model for agentic software and data engineering across Martech
Enable — Drive the evolution from task-oriented AI assistance toward outcome-oriented agentic engineering, where engineers orchestrate agents against defined goals while retaining judgment, oversight and accountability for results
Experiment — Test emerging agentic engineering techniques against real work through prioritized use cases, separating durable value from hype
Productize — Turn proven approaches into reusable golden paths, context patterns, tool/MCP integrations, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and reference implementations
Embed — Work alongside pods on real engineering work to prove productized capabilities, then use the guild to transfer knowledge, tooling and ownership into delivery teams
Measure — Quantify changes in cycle time, throughput, quality, toil, developer experience and capacity, and use the data to determine what scales

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Define clear human and agent decision authority, autonomy boundaries, review expectations and accountability, preserving human ownership of architecture, validation and production outcomes
Define evaluation, testing, auditability and enforceable guardrails for increasingly autonomous engineering agents, including permission controls and fail-safe mechanisms that prevent unintended or unauthorized actions
Identify, document and mitigate agentic engineering anti-patterns where short-term productivity gains create longer-term risks to engineering quality, capability, knowledge, maintainability or accountability
Build a community of practice across Martech that distributes knowledge and capability across teams and reduces dependence on any one person or team
Partner with leaders, teams and shared services across the enterprise to adopt, contribute to and advance shared standards, leading practices and the collective Ulta body of knowledge for agentic engineering

ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, CIS, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
10+ years of progressive experience and technology ownership in software engineering, data engineering, enterprise automation or solution architecture
Demonstrated hands-on experience applying automation and/or agentic capabilities to software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or SDLC workflows, including the ability to contribute production-quality code
Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, distributed systems, cloud, CI/CD, source control, developer tooling, automated testing, observability, security and modern data patterns
Experience with LLM-based development tools, agent orchestration, context engineering, tool integration/MCP, evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop controls
Proven ability to create reusable engineering patterns, reference implementations, standards or enablement capabilities and drive their adoption across multiple engineering teams
Ability to lead through influence, coach senior technical talent, build communities of practice and drive organizational change without direct authority
Strong analytical mindset; able to define success measures and use data to evaluate productivity, quality and developer experience

Description

Join the next science and engineering revolution at Amazon's Delivery Foundation Model team, where you'll work alongside world-class scientists and engineers to pioneer the next frontier of logistics through advanced AI and foundation models.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Applied Scientist to help develop innovative foundation models that enable delivery of billions of packages worldwide. In this role, you'll combine highly technical work with scientific leadership, ensuring the team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. Your team will leverage Amazon's vast data and computational resources to tackle ambitious problems across a diverse set of Amazon delivery use cases.

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement novel deep learning architectures combining a multitude of modalities, including image, video, and geospatial data.
Solve computational problems to train foundation models on vast amounts of Amazon data and infer at Amazon scale, taking advantage of latest developments in hardware and deep learning libraries.
As a foundation model developer, collaborate with multiple science and engineering teams to help build adaptations that power use cases across Amazon Last Mile deliveries, improving experience and safety of a delivery driver, an Amazon customer, and improving efficiency of Amazon delivery network.
Guide technical direction for specific research initiatives, ensuring robust performance in production environments.
Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions.

A day in the life

Develop and implement novel foundation model architectures, working hands-on with data and our extensive training and evaluation infrastructure
Guide and support fellow scientists in solving complex technical challenges, from trajectory planning to efficient multi-task learning
Guide and support fellow engineers in building scalable and reusable infra to support model training, evaluation, and inference
Lead focused technical initiatives from conception through deployment, ensuring successful integration with production systems- Drive technical discussions within the team and and key stakeholders
Conduct experiments and prototype new ideas
Mentor team members while maintaining significant hands-on contribution to technical solutions

About The Team

The Delivery Foundation Model team combines ambitious research vision with real-world impact. Our foundation models provide generative reasoning capabilities required to meet the demands of Amazon's global Last Mile delivery network. We leverage Amazon's unparalleled computational infrastructure and extensive datasets to deploy state-of-the-art foundation models to improve the safety, quality, and efficiency of Amazon deliveries. Our work spans the full spectrum of foundation model development, from multimodal training using images, videos, and sensor data, to sophisticated modeling strategies that can handle diverse real-world scenarios. We build everything end to end, from data preparation to model training and evaluation to inference, along with all the tooling needed to understand and analyze model performance.

Join us if you're excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in logistics, working with world-class scientists and engineers, and seeing your innovations deployed at unprecedented scale.

Basic Qualifications

PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or Master's degree and 10+ years of industry or academic research experience
5+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
Proficient with Data, experience with SQL and Spark
Expert coders comfortable working in production environments using Python, C++ or other languages

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

Build computational methods and workflows that help scientists discover new medicines. Join the small molecule team within Roche/Genentech’s AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD) organization, formerly Prescient Design, to turn advances in cheminformatics, computational chemistry and machine learning into powerful tools for molecular design. Working alongside world-class drug hunters, you will develop, deploy, and support computational methods used in real discovery programs. With access to extensive scientific data, computational resources and drug discovery expertise, you will shape new capabilities and take them from first prototype to everyday use by scientists and AI agents.

In this role, you will:

Develop computational methods and robust, reusable libraries, APIs, and services for small-molecule drug discovery, spanning cheminformatics, molecular modeling, and property prediction.
Partner with medicinal and computational chemists to identify scientific bottlenecks, design practical implementations, and benchmark and validate in drug discovery campaigns.
Own capabilities from prototype through deployment and ongoing use, collaborating with engineering teams to deliver scalable and reliable workflows on cloud and HPC infrastructure.
Shape the team’s technical direction by proposing new computational approaches and raising software quality.
Share scientific and software contributions through publications, open-source tools and presentations at top conferences.

Who You Are

PhD with 0–3 years of relevant experience, or BS/MS with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, in computer science, software engineering, computational chemistry, chemical engineering, or a related quantitative or scientific field such as statistics or physics.
Strong Python programming and software engineering skills, including software design, debugging and performance optimization, with experience in code review, automated testing, packaging, documentation and continuous integration.
Experience developing cheminformatics or computational chemistry workflows using tools such as RDKit, OpenEye or comparable libraries, grounded in an understanding of chemistry and small molecule drug discovery.
Working knowledge of foundational machine learning concepts and experience integrating, deploying, and troubleshooting trained models built with modern ML frameworks.

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Senior MLOps Engineer, Forward Deployed

Forward Deployed Engineering

Predictive track
Senior

TEAM

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Predictive track, in Data Science & AI Engineering

REPORTS TO

MLOps engineering lead

LEVEL

Senior (6+ years)

LOCATION

United States

THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH

This is a hands-on MLOps engineering role. You will work across model training and refresh workflows, APIs, orchestration, data pipelines, production monitoring, and user-facing experiences such as model dashboards and training controls.

When a customer needs a better model, a refresh workflow, or visibility into model health, you will help make it real: build the experience, connect it to reliable backend systems, validate the outcome, and operate it safely in production.

You'll be our first MLOps engineer in the US, working closely with the MLOps team in India so customer work reaches production in days, not weeks. Most of your work is behind the scenes, with customer conversations when the technical details matter.

What You'll Do

Build for the customer

Productionize customer-tailored predictive models, configurations, and scoring workflows with validation, release, monitoring, and rollback paths.
Build and improve UI workflows for training triggers, model refreshes, validation outcomes, model status, and operational troubleshooting.
Enhance model dashboards that make model health, score changes, data quality, refresh status, and production issues understandable to internal users and customers.
Build or modify the APIs, backend services, data contracts, and orchestration workflows behind those experiences.
Automate model retraining, validation, promotion, and deployment workflows for customer engagements.
Create safeguards for data quality, score distributions, threshold changes, and edge cases before model changes reach production.
Monitor models and services for drift, data shifts, reliability issues, and operational regressions.

Productize for everyone

Turn repeatable customer solutions into reusable product and platform capabilities with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering.
Build deployment templates, reusable workflow components, and configuration-driven interfaces that support many customers without one-off operational work.
Create self-service or assisted tools for teams to initiate training, monitor refreshes, review validation results, and troubleshoot model issues safely.
Improve the MLOps platform where needed, including Kubernetes workloads, compute, pipelines, CI/CD, deployment tooling, and observability.
Establish clear runbooks, release checklists, audit trails, and support processes for model operations.
Identify recurring customer pain points and convert them into product requirements, platform improvements, or durable operational tooling.

What You'll Bring

6+ years of experience in MLOps, ML platform engineering, backend engineering, full-stack engineering, or related production engineering roles.
Experience owning machine-learning systems in production, including training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and incident response.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including APIs, backend services, asynchronous workflows, testing, CI/CD, and observability.
Experience building or materially contributing to internal tools, operational dashboards, or customer-facing product workflows.
Comfortable debugging across the stack: UI, APIs, workflows, data pipelines, model artifacts, and production infrastructure.
Experience releasing changes safely across multiple customers or production environments, including staged rollout, impact checks, and rollback.
Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
Strong communication and judgment when balancing customer urgency, usability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
Nice to have: Fast API and Frontend experience.
Airflow, Spark, MLflow, model registries, feature pipelines, or workflow orchestration.
AWS, S3, Hive, distributed compute, and multi-tenant SaaS experience.
Forward-deployed, consulting, solutions, implementation, or customer-facing engineering experience.
B2B SaaS, go-to-market data, or predictive modeling experience.

What Success Looks Like

Within 3 months

Understand the predictive-model lifecycle and improve at least one meaningful deployment, support, or visibility bottleneck.
Bring clear release, monitoring, and support plans to active customer model engagements.

Within 6 months

Common training, refresh, validation, and deployment workflows are materially more automated.
Model dashboards or internal workflows provide clear visibility into model status, health, and refresh progress.
Customer model changes move to production faster, with stronger operational controls.

Within 12 months

At least one customer-specific solution has become a reusable product or platform capability.
The team can reliably deliver and operate customer-tailored models without fragile manual processes or overnight handoffs.

Why this role is different:
You won’t only maintain ML infrastructure. You’ll build the product experiences and production systems that make predictive models easier to launch, understand, refresh, and trust—then turn what works for one customer into something that benefits many.

new_jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with healthcare organizations to deploy production AI systems across clinical, operational, and member-facing workflows. We work at the boundary of customer deployment and core platform development, using customer engagements to define repeatable architectures, evaluations, integrations, and operating standards for complex, regulated healthcare environments.

About The Role

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to own end-to-end deployments of our models within healthcare organizations, including payers, providers, health systems, and healthcare technology companies. You will lead technical discovery, architecture, implementation, evaluation, productionization, and handoff, translating complex customer workflows, data, infrastructure, and regulatory constraints into production AI systems.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and evaluation loops that establish customer-specific benchmarks, acceptance criteria, and launch readiness. You’ll collaborate directly with customer technical and operational teams, alongside internal Business, Research, Product, Engineering, and Security partners, to deliver solutions and translate deployment learnings into product improvements. This role owns the technical solution; ownership of the commercial or executive relationship is not required.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In This Role, You Will

Own the technical solution end to end, from customer discovery and workflow scoping through architecture, hands-on implementation, evaluation, production deployment, adoption, and handoff.
Partner credibly with customer engineers, operators, and domain experts to frame ambiguous problems, define scope, and translate payer, provider, or health-system workflows into technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
Design and implement production AI applications and agentic systems that integrate with customer infrastructure, enterprise APIs, data platforms, electronic health records, claims systems, and operational tools.
Build with appropriate safeguards for protected health information (PHI), HIPAA, privacy, security, authorization, governance, auditability, and other regulated-delivery requirements.
Define and operationalize evaluations, validation evidence, human-review workflows, escalation paths, and launch criteria that measure model and system quality against customer-specific acceptance thresholds.
Use evaluation results, error analysis, observability, and customer feedback to improve system reliability, performance, model selection, workflow impact, and production readiness.
Distill deployment learnings into reference architectures, interoperability and integration patterns, evaluation harnesses, security controls, and reusable technical primitives for healthcare and other regulated enterprise environments.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Bring 6+ years of software engineering, ML/AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience, with the technical depth
Have operated as a senior engineer, tech lead, or deployment owner who is trusted to make technical decisions in ambiguous environments.

Have shipped complex systems as a forward deployed or customer engineer, an engineer inside a payer, provider, or health system, a builder at an EHR, interoperability, revenue cycle, payer-tech, or healthcare infrastructure company, a hands-on technical consultant or integrator, a solutions architect for regulated enterprises, or a technical founder or early engineering leader.
