At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Engineering @ Compass

Compass has built the first modern end-to-end real estate platform by integrating agents, buyers and sellers through technology. Until Compass, no one has achieved the blend of the Natural Intelligence that hundreds of thousands of enterprising real estate agents bring to this market, with the “Artificial Intelligence” that cloud, mobile and AI technologies enable. We are building AI to empower AI - Artificial Intelligence to empower Agent Intelligence.

As one of the fastest growing technology companies of our generation, in an industry larger than any other, we have an opportunity and obligation to build a world-class engineering team and the operating platform that will transform real estate.

Security @ Compass

We are hands-on security engineers helping to build secure, resilient, and scalable web apps, mobile apps, and platforms for the real estate industry. We work with a diverse set of teams to provide transparent and automated security tooling and services. We architect secure products, perform simulated attacks, identify weaknesses, and partner with teams to remediate and protect.

The Role

Compass is embedding generative and agentic AI directly into the products our agents and clients use every day. This role owns the security of that surface. You will be the technical authority on how Compass builds AI features safely, from the model and retrieval layer, through agent tool invocation, to what ultimately reaches a client's screen. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with the teams building the AI platform so that platform standards and security standards are one bar, not two.

What You Will Do

Own the AI product security roadmap. Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and standards for securing AI capabilities in the Compass platform, developed jointly with the AI platform and product engineering teams.
Threat model AI capability builds. Drive architectural reviews and threat modeling for new AI features, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and automated decisioning before they ship.
Build production guardrails. Architect, deploy, and automate real-time protections for LLM inputs and outputs, including injection mitigation, jailbreak defense, output verification, and sensitive-data egress checks on generated responses.
Constrain autonomy. Design blast-radius controls for autonomous agents: scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints for consequential actions, action audit trails, and safe tool-invocation patterns.
Secure the retrieval layer. Enforce data access controls, source integrity, tenancy boundaries, and retrieval-boundary protections across RAG and vector store implementations.
Harden the AI supply chain. Assess the security posture, privacy controls, data retention, and training-use terms of third-party foundation models, inference providers, and vector stores used in production.
Instrument and detect. Build detections and telemetry for AI-specific abuse in production, anomalous tool invocation, prompt abuse patterns, unusual retrieval behavior, and data exfiltration through model responses and integrate them into our monitoring estate.
Automate the standard. Ship reusable libraries, CI/CD checks, and evaluation harnesses so secure AI patterns are the default path for product engineers rather than a review gate.
Advise and evangelize. Act as the primary technical consultant for AI architecture decisions and translate emerging AI risk into concrete engineering roadmaps for both engineers and executives.

Who You Are

Automation is your default approach to security, especially when securing complex AI systems at scale.
You have a deep working understanding of transformer architectures, inference pipelines, RAG, prompt engineering, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs.
You write production code, strong proficiency in Python or Go, with experience building real integrations and security pipelines, not just prototypes.
You are proactive about finding and closing gaps in AI/ML workflows through tooling rather than policy.
You communicate well across audiences, translating emerging AI risk into technical roadmaps for engineers and business impact for leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years in security engineering, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML or LLM application security.
Demonstrated experience securing a production AI or ML system end to end, development lifecycle, deployment, and runtime.
Expertise in adversarial ML and LLM risks including prompt injection, model poisoning, data extraction, and unsafe tool use, with hands-on red teaming experience.
Strong application and cloud security fundamentals: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes, IAM, API security, and DevSecOps practices.
Experience threat modeling complex distributed systems and driving remediation with engineering teams.
Strong strategic communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical AI risk into business impact for executive leadership.

Nice to Have

Experience with multi-agent autonomous systems or Model Context Protocol (MCP) based architectures.
Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, or comparable AI threat/risk frameworks.
Background building evaluation and safety-testing harnesses for LLM applications.
Experience in a regulated or consumer-data-heavy environment where model outputs touch customer-facing decisions.
Prior work on AI platform security architecture or secure-by-default AI SDKs.

Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks That You Need To Know About

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

We are hands-on security engineers helping to build secure, resilient, and scalable web apps, mobile apps, and platforms for the real estate industry. We architect secure products, perform simulated attacks, identify weaknesses, and partner with teams to remediate and protect.

The Role

Compass is embedding generative and agentic AI directly into the products our agents and clients use every day. This role owns the security of that surface. You will be the technical authority on how Compass builds AI features safely, from the model and retrieval layer, through agent tool invocation, to what ultimately reaches a client's screen. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with the teams building the AI platform so that platform standards and security standards are one bar, not two.

What You Will Do

Own the AI product security roadmap. Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and standards for securing AI capabilities in the Compass platform, developed jointly with the AI platform and product engineering teams.
Threat model AI capability builds. Drive architectural reviews and threat modeling for new AI features, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and automated decisioning before they ship.
Build production guardrails. Architect, deploy, and automate real-time protections for LLM inputs and outputs, including injection mitigation, jailbreak defense, output verification, and sensitive-data egress checks on generated responses.

Automate the standard. Ship reusable libraries, CI/CD checks, and evaluation harnesses so secure AI patterns are the default path for product engineers rather than a review gate.

Automation is your default approach to security, especially when securing complex AI systems at scale.

Strong application and cloud security fundamentals: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes, IAM, API security, and DevSecOps practices.

Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, or comparable AI threat/risk frameworks.
Background building evaluation and safety-testing harnesses for LLM applications.
Experience in a regulated or consumer-data-heavy environment where model outputs touch customer-facing decisions.

About Us

Calibr-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines, a division of Scripps Research, is a first-of-its-kind, nonprofit translational research institute dedicated to creating the next generation of medicines. Calibr-Skaggs was founded on the principle that the creation of new medicines can be accelerated by pairing world-class biomedical research with state-of-the-art drug discovery and development capabilities. Scripps Research is ranked one of the most influential institutions in the world for its impact on innovation. Our educational and training programs mold talented and committed students and postdocs into leading edge scientists. Leveraging the unique scientific environment of Scripps Research, impacting translational sciences, Calibr-Skaggs has created a portfolio of drug candidates, and is shaping a new paradigm for advancing nonprofit biomedical research to impact patients while re-investing in further innovative research. We expand basic knowledge in the biosciences and use these fundamental advancements to develop profound innovations that improve wellbeing. Calibr-Skaggs’ drug development portfolio spans a broad range of human diseases, including cancer, autoimmunity and inflammatory diseases, metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, infectious and neglected diseases, as well as age-related and degenerative diseases. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team. This position is based on site at our La Jolla campus.

POSITION TITLE:
Research Scientist - Computational Peptide Chemistry

Position Summary

We are seeking a Research Scientist - Computational Peptide Chemistry to develop and apply machine learning and generative AI approaches for the de novo design and optimization of peptide therapeutics. The role will focus on leveraging diffusion models, protein language models, and physics-based methods to discover novel peptide binders, improve potency and selectivity, and optimize developability properties. You will work closely with interdisciplinary teams of computational scientists, medicinal chemists, and biologists to advance peptide therapeutics, including long-acting peptides and conjugates, toward preclinical development. This is an on site position based on our La Jolla, CA campus.

Responsibilities

Develop and apply generative AI approaches, including diffusion models and protein language models, for de novo peptide design and potency optimization of existing leads.
Design and optimize linear, stapled, and macrocyclic peptides, incorporating non-natural amino acids, backbone modifications, and half-life extension strategies.
Develop machine learning models to predict peptide binding affinity, selectivity, proteolytic stability, solubility, and aggregation.
Integrate generative models with structure prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and free energy calculations to guide peptide design and optimization.
Leverage structural, sequence, and experimental assay data to train, validate, and benchmark predictive and generative models.
Develop automated workflows for peptide generation, virtual screening, multi-parameter optimization, and candidate prioritization.
Collaborate with synthetic chemists and biologists to interpret SAR, prioritize designs, and iteratively improve models using experimental feedback.

Requirements

BS, MS, or PhD in Computational Chemistry, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
Minimum of 1 year of relevant research experience.
Experience developing or applying machine learning models for small molecule, peptide or protein design and/or property prediction.
Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Familiarity with peptide chemistry, protein structure, and molecular interactions.
Strong analytical, programming, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.

Additional Preferences

Experience with structure-based generative design tools (e.g., RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, AlphaFold) for molecular or peptide design.
Experience with peptide potency optimization, binding affinity prediction, and multi-objective molecular optimization.
Knowledge of peptide modifications, including non-canonical amino acids, cyclization, stapling, lipidation, and half-life extension strategies.
Experience with molecular simulations, docking, free energy calculations, or enhanced sampling (e.g., Schrödinger, GROMACS, AMBER, Rosetta).
Familiarity with peptide synthesis constraints, oral bioavailability, and developability optimization.

Physical Requirements

This position works in a laboratory environment. Further details of the physical requirements of established essential functions for this position will be addressed/discussed during the interview process.

Compensation

The expected hiring range for this position is $77,000 - $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Consideration will be given to experience that exceeds the listed requirements.

Comprehensive Benefits Include

Eligibility for retirement plans with employer contribution.
Full suite of Health and Welfare plans including three medical plan options (including an HSA available option), dental, vision, life insurance, disability, EAP and more.
Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical/Dependent Care).

Free, on-site Counseling Center which provides confidential counseling services to benefits-eligible employees and their family members.
Free, on-site parking.

new_jobs.title: Lead/Senior Research Scientist (Agentic RL)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release.

The research team trains and evaluates the Thomson models to perform at a frontier level for professional workflows. We work with a range of large open-weight models and use continual learning to improve them comprehensively, rather than pre-training from scratch or doing narrow fine-tuning. The training pipeline includes value alignment, data-centric mid-training on curated proprietary data, DPO, and reinforcement learning (RL) for product-ready tasks. The evaluation group builds the measurement side: expert-annotated legal and tax benchmarks, agentic systems, and human preference studies with subject-matter experts. We regularly publish work that comes out of our training and evaluation efforts.

We Are Hiring Scientists At Senior And Lead Level Across Three Areas Of Emphasis. In Your Application, Please Tell Us Which One Or Two Fit You Best

Agentic reinforcement learning: post-training for agentic behaviour (planning, long-context reasoning, tool calls, long-horizon tasks inside real agent harnesses), multi-turn RL and policy optimisation, reward modelling and training-signal design.
Model training: continued pre-training and post-training of open-weight models, DPO and RL, training data and reward design, forgetting and replay in continued pre-training.
Model evaluation: benchmarks and targeted evaluations for complex legal and professional workflows, LLM-as-a-judge and rubric design, human preference studies with legal experts, and evaluation results that inform training objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Design new benchmarks, training datasets, rewards and training signals to improve the Thomson model family, including for tasks where ground truth is scarce, delayed or partly subjective.
Design rigorous experiments and diagnostics (for example ablations) that separate algorithmic effects from data, reward and system artefacts, and carry results into production models.
Build and extend the evaluation suite to understand Thomson's strengths and weaknesses, and use the results to inform training objectives and technical trade-offs.
Work hand in hand with Research Engineers on our large-scale training and evaluation infrastructure, and with subject-matter experts in law, tax and other professional domains.
Coordinate with product teams and other model consumers to understand adoption requirements and drive integration.
Publish regularly at top-tier ML and NLP venues and represent Thomson Reuters Labs in the research community.
At Lead level: own a research agenda, turn emerging methods into a roadmap for our models, and mentor scientists and engineers.

Required Qualifications

PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on LLM post-training and/or evaluation experience, preferably at frontier model development scale, using Python and PyTorch.
A track record of research impact you can point to: publications at top-tier venues (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM) and/or work that shaped an LLM development cycle.
Experience working closely with researchers and cross-functional stakeholders, including subject-matter experts, to turn ideas into practical training or evaluation assets.
Excellent written and oral communication, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
For Lead level: 3+ years of research experience after the PhD, a record of leading a research agenda to published or deployed results, and of mentoring or supervising researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with RL post-training frameworks (NeMo-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL) or evaluation frameworks (Inspect, lm-evaluation-harness).
Experience designing LLM-as-a-judge or rubric-based reward and evaluation pipelines and measuring their reliability.
Experience with Mixture-of-Experts or long-context models.
Experience with law, tax or other professional, non-verifiable domains, particularly grounding and citation.
Experience in experimental design and best practices for working with human data.
Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale.

Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!

new_jobs.title: AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Carrix is seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy production applications using Generative AI, frontier LLMs, and agentic AI architectures.

The role combines software engineering, AI/ML, cloud technologies, and enterprise integration to develop multi-agent systems, reusable AI tools and platforms, MCP tools, RAG pipelines, and Python-based services. This is not a traditional data science or model-training role. We are looking for an AI engineer who knows how to use modern foundation models to build real applications. The right candidate should be comfortable moving between an LLM, agent workflow, MCP tool, Python service, RAG pipeline and understand how these pieces come together in a reliable production system.

Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI applications, including agentic and multi-agent systems using frontier LLMs.
Develop agent workflows incorporating reasoning, planning, routing, tool execution, memory, state management, parallel execution, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Build reusable MCP servers, tools, APIs, and Python-based services that connect AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, and internal applications.
Develop RAG and knowledge retrieval solutions using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, reranking, and related techniques.
Evaluate and integrate foundation models, making engineering decisions around model selection, prompting, structured outputs, context management, and multi-model architectures.
Establish evaluation, testing, observability, and monitoring for AI applications, including response quality, grounding, hallucination, tool execution, latency, token consumption, and task completion.
Implement security and access controls for AI systems, including identity and permissions, secrets management, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and safe agent execution; partner with Cybersecurity on AI threat modeling and security requirements.
Partner with Enterprise Applications, Cybersecurity, Data, Infrastructure, and business teams to translate business requirements into AI solutions and move use cases from proof-of-concept through production in accordance with enterprise architecture and responsible AI governance standards.
Create reusable engineering components, patterns, reference implementations, CI/CD pipelines, technical documentation, and runbooks to support broader AI development and ongoing operations.
Evaluate and support local or on-premises AI inference workloads as needed, including GPU-based model serving and production deployment patterns.
Provide coaching, knowledge transfer, and ongoing support for the operation and maintenance of key deployed systems.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
5+ years of software, data, machine learning, or related engineering, including at least 2 years developing Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Proven success taking AI or LLM applications from prototype through production in an enterprise environment
Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Anthropic Claude, Microsoft agent 365, Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock
Strong Python development skills, including production APIs, backend services, and system integrations.
Hands-on expertise with agentic AI architectures, including agent workflows, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
Deep understanding of RAG and knowledge retrieval architectures, including embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and reranking.
Proficiency working with frontier foundation models such as OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, or comparable models.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate and operate LLM applications in production, including testing, tracing, observability, monitoring, and model or response evaluation.
Hands-on experience integrating AI applications with enterprise systems, such as ERP, ITSM, data platforms, APIs, databases, and other business applications.
Working knowledge of enterprise identity and security patterns, including Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, SSO, RBAC, and secure application integration.
Understanding of data privacy, information security, and responsible AI governance as they apply to production AI systems.
Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple countries.
Proficiency with AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or comparable coding agents.
Ability to obtain company-sponsored ITIL Foundation certification within 90 days of employment.

Preferred

Exposure to local or on-premises AI inference and GPU-based model serving.

Experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure as code

new_jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI Cloud Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
About Emerald AI

We’re at a pivotal moment for AI and energy. Demand for compute is skyrocketing, but power constraints are becoming a critical bottleneck. Emerald AI sits at the intersection of these two worlds, enabling AI data centers to scale without overwhelming the grid.

Our Emerald Conductor software platform makes data centers flexible and responsive, allowing them to adjust power usage dynamically. This unlocks massive AI growth without major new infrastructure, while also strengthening the grid and supporting the expansion of renewable energy.

We’re a team of experts across AI, cloud, software, and energy—on a mission to scale AI sustainably. We’re backed by leading investors and partners including Radical Ventures and NVIDIA.

Learn more about our vision, team, and backers at https://www.emeraldai.co/
.

About The Role

Emerald AI is building the world's first power flexible managed cloud infrastructure. We are hiring a senior infrastructure engineer to architect and stand up our managed cloud services from end to end. The work covers the platform, the control plane, and the customer experience that together make up a managed AI cloud.

The right person has done this before. They have built or served as a core early engineer on a managed cloud or AI platform, whether at a GPU cloud, an internal machine learning platform run at scale, a hyperscaler AI service, or a HPC research computing center operated as a service. This is a role for an architect who still builds. You will make the major design decisions and then implement them yourself.

Key Responsibilities

Architect our managed services from 0→1. Define the productization of GPU capacity, encompassing isolation boundaries, tenant models, provisioning flows, and service catalogs that scale across diverse providers.
Engineer the platform core. Build robust control-plane services, self-service customer interfaces, and automated lifecycle systems, including usage metering integrated with billing infrastructure.
Onboard and vet infrastructure partners. Conduct deep technical assessments of bare-metal GPU vendors, evaluating fabric quality, network isolation, and economics to automate the path from handoff to active tenant.
Design end-to-end multi-tenancy. Implement rigorous isolation across compute, storage, and networking (InfiniBand/VLANs), ensuring secure boundaries, QoS, and encryption even when customers possess root access.
Drive workload orchestration. Manage Kubernetes and Slurm environments for large-scale training and inference, overseeing node health, driver fleets, and kernel management across heterogeneous clouds.
Lead high-performance storage strategy. Deploy and integrate parallel storage solutions like Lustre, VAST, or Weka, leveraging your deep experience with these systems to ensure they fold cleanly into our provisioning model.
Ensure operational excellence. Define SLOs, observability standards, and incident response protocols that bridge our internal standards with underlying provider SLAs to deliver a reliable, sellable product.

Minimum Requirements

At least 7+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, including the architecture and launch of a managed cloud or AI platform that reached production users.
Strong experience with Kubernetes and Slurm and offering them as managed service
Production experience deploying or operating Lustre or a comparable parallel filesystem such as GPFS, Weka, VAST, or BeeGFS, with a solid understanding of parallel filesystem architecture, tuning, and failure modes.
A strong grasp of cloud service fundamentals, including control planes, tenancy and isolation models, APIs, quota and metering systems, and the operational discipline of running a service that customers pay for.
Deep Linux systems knowledge, mature infrastructure as code practice with tools such as Terraform and Ansible, and solid programming ability in Python or Go.
Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, including high performance networking with InfiniBand, RoCE, and RDMA, and the GPU software stack.

Preferred Requirements

Description

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect a Senior Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Applied Scientist on this team you will:

Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
Raise the science bar: mentor scientists and engineers, review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

About The Team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

The Research team at HUMAN is eager to protect the internet, and is passionate about innovating and winning against our attackers. What You'll Do

Research and implement innovative ways to identify and block malicious activity, then turn those methods into automated systems that run without a standing human in the loop.
Build and own internal tooling and services that enroll, refresh, and quality-check detections across customers, so protection ships as a normal part of the product rather than a long manual process.

Partner closely with customer success, sales engineering, engineering, product, the rest of Research + Detection so research findings become reliable production behavior, with failures visible and guardrails in place.
Take part in a global core team of researchers and data scientists, with real opportunity to initiate work, reduce cost and toil, and raise detection quality.

Who You Are

8+ years across large-scale data analysis, software engineering, tooling and process automation, and security research — you have shipped production systems, not only analyses.
Strong Python and SQL; comfortable owning warehouse-backed services (Snowflake or equivalent), internal apps, and the glue that takes a decision from query to written config.
A builder who removes operational queues. You have automated a recurring analyst/operator workflow so the happy path no longer needs a ticket, a checklist, or a human-in-the-loop.
A researcher mindset: you form a hypothesis, backtest on historical data, measure FP/FN, and only then write to production. Correctness, cost, and performance are equally important to you.
Knowledge of how the internet works (HTTP, clients, scanning, how traffic actually shows up in logs and warehouses). Familiarity with application-layer attacks, bot or vulnerability signatures, or threat-intelligence collection is a plus.
Proven record of solving messy, high-volume data problems — ingest, quality, scoring, and making failures visible instead of silent.
Strong sense of ownership: you find ways to do things better, faster, and cheaper, and you hold the quality bar when the easy path is “just dump more configs.”
A great team player — open, transparent, and effective with CS, SEs, support teams, and other researchers.
Based in the United States on Eastern Time, able to work closely with our Customer Success, Go-to Market teams, and with a global Research team.
Great motivation to keep learning, and a desire to influence the product rather than sit beside it.

What Will Set You Apart

You have built or extended internet-scale crawling, scanning, or threat-intelligence platforms, and you care about what happens when a detection is wrong.

You have stood up internal operator tooling (dashboards, Slack entry points, plan/state machines) that non-engineers can actually use.
You are at home with streaming and orchestration (Kafka, Airflow, Kubernetes) and with writing production services, not only notebooks.

The ETS Research Institute invites applications for a Senior Research Scientist
position to lead and contribute to a research agenda focused on schooling, human capital development, workforce readiness, and economic mobility in an AI-enabled world. The position will be housed in the Center for Policy Research, a new initiative at ETS dedicated to providing policymakers the research evidence they need to improve education and workforce systems at scale. The Center’s research agenda focuses on the development of foundational skills (e.g., literacy, numeracy, etc.), durable skills (e.g., communication, critical thinking, etc.), and AI literacy in K-12 settings; college-to-career pathways; credentials of value; job training; upskilling; and adult learning.

Particular areas of interest include (1) understanding and measuring the skills and capabilities that drive success in education and labor markets, including how advances in AI are reshaping skill demand, workforce readiness, and pathways to opportunity, and (2) generating evidence on the effectiveness of educational and workforce development pathways, including competency-based education (CBE), career and technical education (CTE), and other approaches designed to promote skill acquisition, employment, earnings growth, and long-term economic mobility.

We seek quantitative scientists to work in a dynamic research environment sitting at the intersection of innovative policy research methods, state-of-the art large scale assessment data, world-class measurement science, and policy impact. Scientists in the Center will directly interface with educational and workforce stakeholders at the federal, state, and local level to scope out policy challenges and produce applied research that can help address those challenges. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience directly collaborating with policymakers to identify evidence-based solutions. The successful candidate will join a growing team advancing ETS’s research agenda focused on policies and programs that impart the knowledge and skills that learners of all ages need for the workforce of the future. The job is based in ETS’ Washington, DC office. Scientists in the Center are expected to represent ETS in the activities and functions of the city’s vibrant policy ecosystem.

Investigate how skills, competencies, credentials, and educational experiences predict educational attainment, employment, earnings growth, productivity, workforce participation, and economic mobility.
Lead the development, evaluation, and translation of research frameworks that inform state and federal education policy, with attention to systems-level change.

Provide policy consultation and technical assistance to policymakers, practitioners, and other stakeholders seeking to apply research evidence to decision-making.

Disseminate research findings to diverse audiences through peer-reviewed publications, policy briefs, convenings, newspaper commentaries, legislative testimony, and blog posts.

This position will be located in Washington, DC

Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following areas: causal inference and quasi-experimental designs, cost-benefit analysis, advanced predictive modeling, longitudinal and panel data analysis, ROI forecasting, analysis of large-scale assessment data, machine learning applications, labor market information and job-postings analytics, linkage and analysis of administrative wage-outcome data systems, policy simulation, microsimulation modeling, and structural dynamic modeling. new_jobs.description:
Discover your potential. Build your legacy.

Go the distance with Capital Group

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.

The Role

As a Lead Architect – AI & Agentic Systems, you’ll define and build the AI architecture that shapes how Capital Group serves clients and empowers associates across sales, marketing, product, and client engagement. You’ll set the target state for Agentic AI, including multi-agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, evaluation, and guardrails, and you’ll be responsible for prototyping reference implementations, writing and reviewing code, and working side by side with engineering teams to move high-value use cases from experimentation into governed production. As a hands-on technical leader, you’ll help Capital Group own what matters most — the agent orchestration layer, the data and knowledge layer, and the associate and client experience — while integrating third-party agents and enterprise SaaS platforms where they deliver value faster. Your work will ensure our AI investments compound into reusable enterprise capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

The Team

You’ll join the AI & Data Architecture team, led by our Principal AI & Data Architect and working closely with business, product, engineering, data governance, risk, and enterprise AI and platform leaders across the firm. The team defines target state architecture for AI and data across our sales, marketing, product, and client engagement capabilities, writes the reference architectures and decision records that guide delivery, and works hands-on with engineering teams to prove patterns before they scale. Together, you’ll help leaders move AI and data initiatives from promising pilots to trusted, governed, reusable enterprise capabilities.

Your Impact

Shape target state AI architecture and roadmaps, including the interim states needed to move AI solutions from pilot to production at scale, aligned with enterprise AI platform direction and business priorities.
Apply clear build, buy, and partner principles — build where proprietary data creates competitive advantage, buy or partner for standard capabilities — and assess opportunities against business value and readiness, including data availability, integration complexity, and change impact.
Serve as solution architect for high-impact AI programs, producing architecture blueprints, points of view, product requirements, and architecture decision records that carry decisions through delivery and architecture review.
Design and build multi-agent solutions spanning orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, human-in-the-loop review, and deterministic workflow controls, running on governed production agent runtimes such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
Ground agents in trusted enterprise knowledge through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and GraphRAG patterns that combine vector search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic layers.
Define how agents securely reach enterprise tools and data, including CRM, marketing and content platforms, enterprise data platforms, identity, and compliance systems, through APIs, events, Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability.
Establish a resilient, multi-provider model strategy, including model selection and routing, capacity and failover across cloud providers, and cost and latency management.
Operationalize LLMOps and AgentOps practices, including evaluation harnesses for individual agents and orchestrators, golden datasets, prompt and model versioning, observability, and feedback loops.
Embed Responsible AI by design through guardrails, grounding and fact-checking, access-aware retrieval, privacy and PII controls, auditability, and appropriate human oversight.
Define and maintain reference architectures, AI standards, and reusable agent components — tool and connector templates, evaluation and guardrail frameworks, and agent naming, tagging, and observability standards — so that agents and tools are reusable across use cases.
Evaluate AI models, vendors, and platforms on architectural fit, security, extensibility, cost, and long-term strategic value, and translate a fast-moving market into pragmatic guidance.
Conduct architecture reviews and provide hands-on guidance, troubleshooting, and coaching that raises the engineering bar for AI solutions.

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; an advanced degree in AI, machine learning, or data science is a plus.
10+ years of architecture and engineering experience in large organizations, including 3+ years designing and delivering machine learning, generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions into production.
A proven track record of defining target state architectures and transformation roadmaps and carrying them through delivery.
Hands-on experience building Agentic AI solutions with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent, foundation model platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, and tool-calling and interoperability protocols such as MCP.
Deep expertise in RAG architectures, including embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking, vector stores, and knowledge graphs.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and modern application, API, integration, and event-driven architecture, including cloud-native services on AWS, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
Practical experience with evaluation, observability, and quality engineering for LLM and agent applications in production.
Understanding of AI governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, and model risk, including prompt injection, data leakage, and frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, and an understanding of how data quality, semantics, and lineage determine AI outcomes.
Strong strategic judgment and executive communication, with the ability to influence technical direction across teams, and to lead and inspire architects and engineers, particularly in ambiguous environments.
A background in financial services or asset management, particularly sales, marketing, or distribution, is a plus.

What You’ll Get

When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. And as a privately held firm built for the long term, we offer the opportunity and support to build a career that lasts.

Live the experience
. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where our passion for better solutions
drives us and is core to who we are.

We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no-holds-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN MAKE:

Ulta is seeking an Architect, Martech Agentic Engineering to transform how Martech builds and operates software and data products by making agentic engineering practical, effective, safe, and reusable. This hands-on technical leader will establish the agentic engineering operating model, practices, tooling, reusable capabilities and guardrails that make AI-enabled engineering effective, safe and scalable. Operating as a center for enablement, the role will pioneer new ways of working and then embed those capabilities across delivery teams through a hub-and-spoke model.

YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Define — Define the technical vision, architecture, tooling strategy, standards, and operating model for agentic software and data engineering across Martech
Enable — Drive the evolution from task-oriented AI assistance toward outcome-oriented agentic engineering, where engineers orchestrate agents against defined goals while retaining judgment, oversight and accountability for results
Experiment — Test emerging agentic engineering techniques against real work through prioritized use cases, separating durable value from hype
Productize — Turn proven approaches into reusable golden paths, context patterns, tool/MCP integrations, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and reference implementations
Embed — Work alongside pods on real engineering work to prove productized capabilities, then use the guild to transfer knowledge, tooling and ownership into delivery teams
Measure — Quantify changes in cycle time, throughput, quality, toil, developer experience and capacity, and use the data to determine what scales

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Define clear human and agent decision authority, autonomy boundaries, review expectations and accountability, preserving human ownership of architecture, validation and production outcomes
Define evaluation, testing, auditability and enforceable guardrails for increasingly autonomous engineering agents, including permission controls and fail-safe mechanisms that prevent unintended or unauthorized actions
Identify, document and mitigate agentic engineering anti-patterns where short-term productivity gains create longer-term risks to engineering quality, capability, knowledge, maintainability or accountability
Build a community of practice across Martech that distributes knowledge and capability across teams and reduces dependence on any one person or team
Partner with leaders, teams and shared services across the enterprise to adopt, contribute to and advance shared standards, leading practices and the collective Ulta body of knowledge for agentic engineering

ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, CIS, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
10+ years of progressive experience and technology ownership in software engineering, data engineering, enterprise automation or solution architecture
Demonstrated hands-on experience applying automation and/or agentic capabilities to software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or SDLC workflows, including the ability to contribute production-quality code
Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, distributed systems, cloud, CI/CD, source control, developer tooling, automated testing, observability, security and modern data patterns
Experience with LLM-based development tools, agent orchestration, context engineering, tool integration/MCP, evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop controls
Proven ability to create reusable engineering patterns, reference implementations, standards or enablement capabilities and drive their adoption across multiple engineering teams
Ability to lead through influence, coach senior technical talent, build communities of practice and drive organizational change without direct authority
Strong analytical mindset; able to define success measures and use data to evaluate productivity, quality and developer experience
Excellent communication and learning agility, with the ability to translate complex technology into clear recommendations while navigating a rapidly evolving AI landscape

new_jobs.title: Software Implementation - Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

The Software Implementation - Solution Architect is responsible for designing, documenting, and delivering end-to-end technical solutions that support utility digital transformation initiatives and align with customer business objectives, technical ecosystems, and operational requirements. This role partners closely with customers, Product, Engineering, and Customer Operations teams to develop scalable, innovative solutions that create measurable value for utility organizations and their field operations.

The ideal candidate is customer-centric, authentic, accountable, agile, collaborative, and innovative, with a passion for solving complex business challenges through technology. This individual serves as a trusted advisor, helping customers achieve successful business outcomes through strategic solution design and technical leadership.

Duties & Responsibilities

Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business goals, technical environments, and operational requirements through consultative engagement, discovery sessions, and solution design workshops.
Translate customer needs into scalable, innovative, and sustainable solution recommendations that align with business objectives and operational priorities.
Design end-to-end software solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing customer systems, processes, and technology ecosystems.
Lead requirements gathering, business process analysis, process mapping, and solution documentation for enterprise software implementations.
Architect and support integrations between business-critical applications, platforms, and data environments using APIs and other integration methods.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Customer Operations, and implementation teams to deliver customer-centric solutions that drive adoption and long-term value.
Serve as a trusted advisor by balancing technical, operational, and business requirements to guide customers toward successful outcomes.
Develop architecture diagrams, technical specifications, solution documentation, and implementation artifacts that support delivery excellence.
Contribute to architecture standards, governance practices, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, quality, maintainability, and innovation.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and agile working environment that encourages knowledge sharing, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Support digital transformation initiatives within utility and energy organizations by aligning technology solutions with customer business strategies.
Remain accountable for solution quality, customer satisfaction, and successful project outcomes from design through implementation.

Required Skills & Experience

5-7 years of experience designing, implementing, supporting, or architecting complex enterprise software solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and practical experience.
Strong technical foundation in software architecture, systems integration, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, or technology implementation.
Experience gathering, analyzing, and translating business and technical requirements into actionable solution designs.
Demonstrated ability to build authentic relationships and collaborate effectively with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex challenges and develop practical, scalable solutions.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience creating solution architecture documentation, technical specifications, workflows, and implementation plans.
Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when needed, and remain accountable for delivering customer-focused outcomes.
Experience working in agile, cross-functional environments with a collaborative and inclusive mindset.
Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and improving customer experiences through technology.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience supporting utilities, energy, infrastructure, telecommunications, or other asset-intensive industries.
Experience with enterprise platforms and technologies such as SAP, IBM Maximo, Esri ArcGIS, GIS, work management systems, asset management systems, or related enterprise solutions.
Experience designing and supporting API-based integrations and enterprise system architectures.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, and enterprise software implementation methodologies.
Experience facilitating customer workshops, discovery sessions, architecture reviews, or digital transformation initiatives.
Experience creating architecture diagrams, solution design documentation, technical roadmaps, and implementation artifacts.
Experience contributing to technical standards, architecture governance, best practices, or mentoring team members.
Familiarity with utility operations, field service management, workforce management, or asset lifecycle management processes.
Demonstrated ability to innovate and identify opportunities to improve business processes, workflows, and technology utilization.
Professional certifications in architecture, cloud technologies, integration platforms, or enterprise applications are desirable.

Physical Demands: This is a typical office job, with no special physical requirements or unusual work environment.

Travel: 30-40%

Benefits Info

This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more! This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience and may vary by location. Chicago, IL: The base salary is $105,000 to $202,000.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com
